name: Deb Haaland
subject: the fierce Indigenous women who made me who I am
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
Here’s what I’m reminded of this Indigenous Peoples’ Day: History doesn’t just happen. We have to fight and make it together.
It’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, Peter, so I want to take a moment to honor some of the fierce Indigenous women who made me who I am.
**[But first, I’m running to represent all New Mexicans and give a voice to those who don’t have one. With the polls already open and only 22 days to go until Election day, will you split $5 between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help make history in New Mexico?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)**
From my great-grandmother, mother and many before them, I’ve been blessed to come from generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)
My mother, Mary Toya, was born and raised in a boxcar, where the Laguna people created a community far from their home. She proudly served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and devoted 25 years to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)
Standing on the shoulders of the Indigenous women who came before me, I found the courage to fight for something bigger than myself and become the leader I am today.
I became one of the first Native American women elected to Congress, and later made history as the first Native American Cabinet Secretary. Those moments were bigger than me. They showed our young people that they can see themselves in places they had never seen themselves before.
And I carried the lessons of the women who raised me into every one of those roles. They taught me that you show up for your community. You take care of your people. And when something isn’t right, you fight to make it better.
That is what I did in Congress. It is what I did as Secretary. And it is what I will continue to do for the people of New Mexico as Governor.
My Pueblo roots taught me to care for our land, our communities, and our people. My roots here run 35 generations deep, and I carry those generations with me every day.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)
**But here’s what I’m reminded of this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, Peter: History doesn’t just happen._We have to fight and make it together._**
**[No state in America has ever elected a Native American woman as governor. With polls open and 22 days left, would you consider helping us finish this fight as strongly as possible by splitting a donation of $5 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots? Your support could help make history in this race.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)**
If you have stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Deb Haaland and Heartland Patriots will process instantly:
[Contribute $5](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=7&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC
) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=9&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=10&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=11&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109829?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=12&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/109828?refcode=em20261012-11000&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=13&akid=11000%2E614464%2E4pWdyC)

Deb

plans quickly fizzled out. I was cut from my college basketball team, and
nearly flunked out of organic chemistry... on the same day.

It wasn’t until someone knocked on my dorm room door and asked if I wanted
to run for student government, I began to seriously think about elected
office. And when I won? I saw exactly what dependable, commonsense
leadership could accomplish.

During my year as Student Association president, I was laser-focused on
safety. We added more outdoor lights, blue light security phones, and even
improved our shuttle service at night.

Seeing my work make a real difference in folks’ lives — it was an amazing
feeling. And I’ve been doing the same ever since. Working hard to make
sure folks can be safe and feel safe in their communities, putting more
money in families’ pockets, bringing folks together, and protecting your
Constitutional freedoms from those who want to sabotage them.

Look, I know politics gets a bad rap — and a lot of the time, it’s
justified.

But I saw it in college then, and I’m seeing it today as your Governor:
Good things happen when leaders are focused on delivering for others.

I’m damn proud of everything we’ve accomplished together,
Derek. But I’m not naive: The
far-right has piles of cash stashed away to boost a candidate who is
solely focused on appeasing Donald Trump — not the good people of
Pennsylvania. So today, I’m humbly asking: [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17044?t=1003&akid=607%2E245147%2EuSSh9t ]Will you chip in a donation
of any amount to help us stay on track for victory here in Pennsylvania? I
know we’ll have what it takes to win on Election Day, but only if folks
like you get off the sidelines and into the game.

subject: I’ve seen what happens when government shows up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I recently stood in a room full of Delaware Democrats and said something I want you to hear too.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3966%2E21716%2EekBeMS)
I recently stood in a room full of Delaware Democrats and said something I want you to hear too.
As Democrats, we don’t seek power for power’s sake. **We seek it to deliver for people** , and to make a real difference in the lives of working people across Delaware and across the country.
I believe that because I’ve seen what happens when government shows up.
In Delaware, Democrats raised the minimum wage. We passed paid family and medical leave, so no one has to choose between a paycheck and being there for someone they love. We’re building more affordable housing and fighting to make sure every child has a strong public school and quality, affordable early education.
**That’s what it looks like when power is used to deliver.**
But those aren’t the values of the Republican Party — in Dover _or_ in D.C. They’re not fighting to lower your costs, raise your wages, or make sure you can care for your family without losing your job. Instead, they’re working to give tax breaks to the billionaires who cut huge checks for their campaigns.
This year, our country marked 250 years since we declared that all of us are created equal. That promise of dignity and opportunity for everyone, no matter who you are or the family you’re born into, still isn’t finished. But as Democrats, we can get us closer.
**So today, I’m asking you to help me keep delivering.** This November, we need to keep Delaware’s seat in Congress blue and elect Democrats across the country so we can flip the House.
My entire team and I are working every day to make sure as many Delawareans as possible hear our message—but that work takes resources, and unlike Republicans, I’m not calling up billionaires to cut me a check every day. Instead, I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to power my campaign every step of the way.
[**If you believe, as I do, that our government should work to make life better for _everyone_ , can I count on you to pitch in $5 or any amount to support my campaign today?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20261012-2.8j1Kl-&refcode=em20261012-3966&amount=5&t=2&akid=3966%2E21716%2EekBeMS)

Thank you — with your support, I know we can keep this beautiful American experiment going for another 250 years.
Sarah McBride

# They want you to think this race is over. It isn’t.
---
| | | | | | Friend,
Today the Albuquerque Journal and Research & Polling Inc. released a new poll, and R&P’s president, Brian Sanderoff, is already telling reporters that time is running out for our campaign.
I’m not buying it, and you shouldn’t either.
In the Journal’s last poll, we had a 17 point lead in the Las Cruces area. Now, somehow, that has completely flipped? **So which poll was flawed? The last one, or this one?**
Here’s what else you should know. Over nine days of calls, only one came after the debate my opponent skipped. Most of the people in this poll answered before New Mexicans saw me standing next to an empty lectern, answering questions she wouldn’t. The poll also builds its sample from 2024 voters, a presidential year when turnout is always far higher than in a governor’s race. A lot of those voters won’t cast a ballot this November.
We’ve seen this before. In the final week of our primary, the polls said it was close. **We won by 10.**
A poll like this does one thing: it tells Republicans and independents that the race is decided so they’ll stay home. That’s exactly what Deb Haaland needs to happen. **She has spent millions upon millions of dollars, much of it from out of state, and she still hasn’t moved the needle since August. She’s stuck.** A large share of independents haven’t made up their minds.
That’s not a race that’s over. That’s a race we can win.
Will you chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now to help us reach every undecided voter before November 3?

| | Peter, We want to tell you about a few important dates in history. **1789.** The U.S. Senate convenes for the first time. In the 237 years since, no Native American woman has ever served in it. Peggy Flanagan and Mary Peltola could become the first two this November. **1948.** New Mexico finally lets Native Americans vote. But EMILYs List knew Keisha Lance Bottoms could make this race competitive — and that’s exactly what she’s done. We backed Keisha because we knew she was in it for the right reasons: to fight for Georgia families no matter the obstacles. She built a campaign and messaging strategy about just that — and has been crisscrossing the state to hear directly from voters about the challenges they’re facing and how Georgia’s next governor can make a difference in their lives. Then there’s Lindsay James , who is running for the open seat in Iowa’s 2nd Congressional District — a district Republicans won comfortably just two years ago. That didn’t stop us from backing Lindsay and fighting to put the district in play while others thought we were reaching for too much. We knew that she’d bring the same drive and empathy to IA-02 that she has shown as a chaplain and Iowa state representative. Today, this is a highly competitive race, with multiple election forecasters placing it in “Toss-Up” territory. That’s what early support does. I can say this with confidence: EMILYs List women up and down the ballot are competing in races that many people once overlooked. Hi there! It's Peggy Flanagan — the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota. Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141242105/652911071/-1804962258?refcode=em20261012&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRjYzc3MjY2LTQ1YzYtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KgJhJUjHmUJBUB2209V7csx2KvmksixUDIm62Y8D-hs=) I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life. Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that. _**But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate.**_ It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. name: Roy Cooper
subject: re: the GOP's attacks
body:
I need your help to be ready for whatever Republicans throw our way.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1642&source=&t=1&akid=4382%2E124072%2EjIGDHW) | | | | Peter,
---
Last month, President Trump came to the town where my opponent now lives for a massive MAGA rally.
Apparently, that still wasn’t enough: **The following week, JD Vance joined Michael Whatley here in NC on the campaign trail.**
See, the Vice President and his entire party know that if they can just stop me from winning in NC, that’s the ballgame. Republicans will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
That’s why Trump has spent millions from his super PAC to bail out Whatley’s campaign and why the VP doubled back last month.
The worst part is that with 22 days until Election Day, it’s working. **We’re facing our last FEC fundraising deadline on Wednesday – and if we don't hit our $3 million goal before then, we won’t have the resources to respond. name: Houston Gaines
subject: Early Voting Starts Tomorrow! Plus, Watch Our Two New Ads
body:
Our newest ads are on TV, early voting begins tomorrow, and we're working hard to finish strong!
| | | | |
---
| Early Voting Starts Tomorrow!
It's hard to believe, but early voting begins TOMORROW, Tuesday, October 13! We're just three weeks away from Election Day, and I want to encourage you to make a plan to vote early.
We're working hard to finish strong across all 20 counties of Georgia's 10th District, and every vote matters. Please encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to get out and vote, too. We need a strong turnout.
Early voting runs October 13-30, and you can vote at any early voting location in your county.
[CLICK HERE TO FIND YOUR EARLY VOTING LOCATIONS & HOURS](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxdqk7AjvnwYdaBDOWXXaAUwOzakxa2x5DGXEl4RC2xNaj2VpXpJwKH7888p-rd2epp44JOjlQtAO8otV7KZKREx7sSYg7hd5ybb_kAIMrY5FvAxDnhqllK9ceAVjgkLmp5EDVoeWQR7tX1wHP4ISX4=&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==)
---
| |
---
| Check out our newest ads!
---
| I wanted to share our two newest campaign ads with you. They're each just 15 seconds long, and both highlight something important to me. Both debuted on TV Saturday during College GameDay.
---
| | | [](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxdqk7AjvnwY1bIXN6YBZ2dgxDXpYFYAXSeXP3hHpphYCSqosZDXyp5X15nOwiw-GQU2nmrPgjS3bV8ieg-zl7pp4j1UcfkOkBIklJxLeO-Uyi9P8AllxVlPlBZIUVArBR6i_TP3Yoxr&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==)
---
Standing Up for Georgia Families
When tragedy struck the Nix family, they reached out to me. I listened, stood by their side, and worked to help them. Their story is one I'll never forget, and it's why I got involved in public service in the first place.
Watch [HERE](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxdqk7AjvnwY1bIXN6YBZ2dgxDXpYFYAXSeXP3hHpphYCSqosZDXyp5X15nOwiw-GQU2nmrPgjS3bV8ieg-zl7pp4j1UcfkOkBIklJxLeO-Uyi9P8AllxVmo3Qbbo609X0y5eIO1vY6-&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==) and please click "share" to your Facebook page!
---
| | | [](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxdqk7AjvnwY3ASbdnREyzJE3GIHKoucJ4Cr09GDyn6Q8CFVsBAHgMjQaxAP1qLXqD3PUJ_KIUWGJEkTS2jIyUnk4CE-7Gja-IuDUcUROHw-NqvraMYdMLJMPmSO5B39n8RKWGAVpDrw&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==)
---
Proud to Back the Blue
I'm incredibly honored to have the support of sheriffs across the district. They know my record of standing with law enforcement, supporting those who protect our communities, and getting things done.
Watch [HERE](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxdqk7AjvnwY3ASbdnREyzJE3GIHKoucJ4Cr09GDyn6Q8CFVsBAHgMjQaxAP1qLXqD3PUJ_KIUWGJEkTS2jIyUnk4CE-7Gja-IuDUcUROHw-NqvraMYdMLKLo01T0Uab-E7I7JCeEeVL&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==) and please click "share" to your Facebook page!
---
|
### Help Us Keep These Ads on the Air!

We're making our final push to reach voters before November 3, and we need your help! Keeping these ads on the air and reaching voters across all 20 counties takes resources.
If you're able to [chip in](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxETMUrsHOt4hhrA-yEIhs8ol5fW54JBNgB08AtElJam4aPDc04h0KdcyTxfUOPlhhfLMqnQNA3id2_L9Xj37aZPDV9RUp4rFrn2cMgBrrCog5vfp2OnrVGr2TaW2VSqnQSulw0h8FdvhbB7B4_8eh8=&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==) any amount, I'd be incredibly grateful for your support as we head into these final weeks.
---
| [DONATE TO HELP US FINISH STRONG](https://a89bm49ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001vjmv6cv2nFP6chHUNtY9oe_mytbw68dKCUgBiEDSQdTbsBejO6oBHxETMUrsHOt4hhrA-yEIhs8ol5fW54JBNgB08AtElJam4aPDc04h0KdcyTxfUOPlhhfLMqnQNA3id2_L9Xj37aZPDV9RUp4rFrn2cMgBrrCog5vfp2OnrVGr2TaW2VSqnVnE4LJzUTGztw08ki-LfIc=&c=clo3NPae_qMr2uW8yWuxt-O5KYbzbF_H2X6qER2WB6KH5C3zXAB2Iw==&ch=l9ce9OSLVrC1wAdMQxTXZ1Ipfamb29ckl1YR8aj4QVAs0M7L9VTMMw==)
---
| |
---
| An Update on the Trail
---
| |
---
What a month it's been! We've put more miles on my truck than I can count, traveling throughout Northeast Georgia and visiting with folks in communities across the 20 counties in the 10th District.
One of my favorite parts of campaigning is the opportunity to meet so many great people, hear their stories, and learn more about the issues that matter most to their families. We've had a busy few weeks! Here are just a few highlights:
* Welcoming my friend Congressman Jim Jordan to Watkinsville for a fantastic campaign event. We also held successful fundraisers in Morgan County, Walton County, Hart County, Jackson County, Atlanta, and more.
* Speaking at UGA's Fight Against Suicide event and reading to Pre-K students at Masters Academy and East Jackson Elementary.
* Celebrating the opening of the new Georgia State Patrol and Department of Driver Services facilities in Oconee County.
* Visiting Hartwell to hear concerns about water levels at Lake Hartwell and meeting with local farmers about challenges facing our agricultural community.
* Visiting Piedmont College for a health care discussion with Dr. Oz.
* Joining Rick Jackson and our other statewide and local candidates at events across Northeast Georgia.
* And, of course, we've enjoying some great UGA football along the way. Go Dawgs!

To everyone who has hosted an event, volunteered, contributed, or offered a word of encouragement along the way: THANK YOU! Gabi and I are incredibly grateful for your friendship and support. We've built tremendous momentum, and we're going to spend every day between now and November 3 working as hard as we can to finish strong.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
---
## Help Us Get Out The Vote!
---
|
---
We need your help during these final three weeks!
Every Wednesday evening through Election Day, our team is hosting volunteer call nights in downtown Athens. We're calling voters across the district, encouraging folks to vote early, and helping turn out a strong vote on Election Day. We'd love to pack the office every Wednesday!
If you can join us--or want to volunteer in another way--please email James Fiveash at [james@houstongaines.com](mailto:james@houstongaines.com).
Or if you know of a community event we should attend, please send James a note. We're working to visit as many communities as possible before Election Day.
I can't thank you enough for everything you've done to get us to this point. It's been an incredible journey, and I'm excited about what lies ahead.
Let's finish strong and bring home a big victory on November 3!
Your friend,
Houston
---
|
---
---
| | | | Gaines for Congress | P.O. Box 48013 | Athens, GA 30604 US
---

The Rose Garden is almost sacred at night.

When the cameras are gone and the noise of the day finally fades, it stops being a backdrop for press conferences and power plays.

It becomes what it was always meant to be: a quiet, living garden right beside the White House.

**And last evening, in what could be my final 4 weeks as President, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared as I strolled alongside the rose bushes.**

Even when it would have been easier to write me off.

For the past decade, the Radical Left has done everything in their power in an attempt to destroy the MAGA coalition.

They came for me, my family, friends, and above all: my supporters.

People like you, Friend.

When the chips were down, you stared evil straight in the face and never flinched.

You put your career, family, and even LIFE on the line to continue supporting me, and I will never be able to thank you enough.

Every single day I wake up, I pray and thank God for his blessing of being able to be your President.
And every night I go to sleep, I pray for the opportunity to spend one more day fighting to make America Great Again.

**And in the Rose Garden late last evening, I made one final prayer before leaving:**

**_That my supporters will keep their trust in me one final time and help see the rest of my mission through._****_

I refuse to go quietly and allow the Radical Left one final victory.

After everything we have built - after the strength we restored, the borders we secured, the voices we gave back to forgotten Americans - we cannot stop when we are so close to Making America Great Again.

clean_body: Tonight, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared. | | THIS COULD BE MY FINAL 4 WEEKS AS PRESIDENT Never in the history of my Presidency have I sent anything quite like this to my supporters. Dear Friend, this is your only warning. What I'm about to share with you is emotional \- PREPARE YOURSELF. ** The Rose Garden is almost sacred at night. When the cameras are gone and the noise of the day finally fades, it stops being a backdrop for press conferences and power plays. It becomes what it was always meant to be: a quiet, living garden right beside the White House. And last evening, in what could be my final 4 weeks as President, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared as I strolled alongside the rose bushes. ****** Your faith in me still humbles me more than I can put into words. From the highest of highs to the lowest of lows, I have always been able to count on your support. From an unproven, underdog political candidate to the leader of our nation's GREATEST movement in history, you have always stood by my side. Even when it would have been easier to write me off. For the past decade, the Radical Left has done everything in their power in an attempt to destroy the MAGA coalition. They came for me, my family, friends, and above all: my supporters. People like you, Friend. When the chips were down, you stared evil straight in the face and never flinched. You put your career, family, and even LIFE on the line to continue supporting me, and I will never be able to thank you enough. Every single day I wake up, I pray and thank God for his blessing of being able to be your President. And every night I go to sleep, I pray for the opportunity to spend one more day fighting to make America Great Again. And in the Rose Garden late last evening, I made one final prayer before leaving: That my supporters will keep their trust in me one final time and help see the rest of my mission through. As you read my message, the Radical Left all across the country are rallying. From our cities to the countryside, dangerous socialists and communists are preparing to destroy our Republican Majorities in the House and the Senate. I refuse to go quietly and allow the Radical Left one final victory. After everything we have built - after the strength we restored, the borders we secured, the voices we gave back to forgotten Americans - we cannot stop when we are so close to Making America Great Again. Here, in the Rose Garden, I'm not asking for your support as President. I am asking for your support as a fellow American who will do anything for his country. I am asking for one more show of faith. clean_body: There's a coordinated liquidation happening There's a coordinated liquidation happening | | | | | Peter, When politicians realized that openly selling off public lands was political suicide, they didn’t stop trying. They just changed tactics. Now, they are using a bureaucratic loophole called "land exchanges" to quietly carve up our national heritage and hand it over to their biggest corporate donors. Here is what is happening right now behind closed doors: In Yosemite: A luxury real estate developer desperately wanted a private road built through Yosemite National Park to connect to their new resort. Multiple administrations denied them for years. Then the CEO started cutting massive checks to political campaigns. Suddenly, Washington is actively negotiating a land swap to give this developer a private slice of Yosemite. In Texas: The administration is pushing through an "expedited" deal to hand over 715 acres of the Lower Rio Grande Valley National Wildlife Refuge to Elon Musk's SpaceX, paving over sacred sites and endangered wildlife habitat to build a rocket launchpad. In Virginia: They are trying to carve 36 acres out of Prince William Forest Park, trading it away to a corporate developer who wants to drop four 100-foot-tall AI data centers right near the headwaters of a pristine creek. The lobbyist who brokered the deal? A former senior political appointee. They are treating our crown jewel national parks and wildlife refuges like a private clearance rack for well-connected tech billionaires and real estate developers. You take our land—we take your seat. For the wild, Public Land Warriors | Public Land Warriors728 Gilbert StHelena, MT 59601United States "Website"

The Organizing To Victory Podcast with Darryl Block
Host Lee Perry sits down with Darryl Block, an attorney, certified mediator, former social worker, youth sports coach, and baseball dad running for Florida House District 36 in Seminole County.
Darryl shares the deeply personal story behind his campaign, including losing his son 8 days after his family lost their health insurance while their child was in the ICU. Later, his own health insurance and regular checkups helped detect a heart condition and save his life. These experiences shaped his commitment to making healthcare accessible and affordable for every family.
In this episode, we discuss:
* • Healthcare access and affordable insurance
* • Public education, teacher pay, and school closures
* • Rising utility bills and property insurance costs
* • Protecting Seminole County's rural boundary and natural lands
* • Local control and home rule
* • Strengthening unions and funding public schools
* • Data centers and Flock surveillance cameras
* • Florida's Amendment 3 and understanding what's on the ballot

Darryl is running to bring his experience serving families and communities to Tallahassee and address the issues affecting everyday Floridians. Listen to or watch Episode 45 wherever you get your podcasts, or visit organizingtovictory.com. Learn more about Darryl's campaign at BlockFor36.com.

This is it: the final sprint. We are 22 days away from Election Day, and there will be no participation medal for this race. There’s no second chance at this, no slo-mo or rewind buttons. **We are within reach of victory, but we need every day, every door, and every dollar to get there. ** We have been running full speed for ten months, and we are seeing the results. After 200+ doctors and nurses endorsed us last week, a dozen current and former Republicans just launched Republicans for Perriello, helmed by former Rep. Denver Rigglemen. We are building a Coalition for Common Sense that is laser-focused on getting costs down, paychecks up and corruption out. Tens of thousands of local voters are turning away from the corruption, chaos and cruelty of this Congress, but that is not enough. We need to do the work to earn their faith that this campaign matters to them. That having me in Congress will meaningfully improve their lives. I know that is true, but I know that proving it takes work. **So let me just say this: I know that this campaign and coalition is ready to run through the tape. We are ready to keep running until we have delivered those results for our communities and our Constitution.** We don’t have an enthusiasm problem. We’ve got energy like I’ve never seen before, and a grassroots movement that spans every corner of the Fighting Fifth. _What we’re in danger of having is a resources problem._ With Cook Political Report and Fox News shifting the VA-05 race rating away from safely Republican, MAGA Inc. and outside groups are taking notice, and they are ready to flood our TV screens and mailboxes. We need to respond to every false flyer with facts. We need to respond to every attack ad with truth. We need to put fuel in the tank, literally, to keep reaching every fair, festival, and VFW hall. And we need to show the national party and donors how powerful the momentum here is. We’re facing our final FEC filing deadline before the midterms this Wednesday – October 14th. This report could show a campaign ready to fight through to victory. And I need your help to do that. **I’m trying to raise another $30K before Wednesday's deadline, and while I wish I could talk to each and every one of you in person or on the phone, there are literally not enough hours in the day – so I’m asking you to help me out by contributing to this email.** **[Will you split a donation between my campaign and Tim Kaine's Common Ground PAC right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141245292/652922807/1139833646?refcode=261012em_tp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODkyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDViZGU4NC00Y2M2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=szQIkLXV5I-ITuZvzjVyyiiKr3RVbcNQZNyuYBZ3Bp4=)**

This district has the largest concentration of Navy families in America. We understand the consequences of endless, ill-planned wars more than most.

That’s why, as a member of Congress, I got results for veterans, active duty members, and military families. I served on the House Armed Services Committee. Then in 2022, MAGA pushed me out of my seat because I investigated their actions on January 6th.

Now I’m back because our current representative is betraying our men and women in uniform.
* She voted seven times against resolutions to end the unauthorized Iran war or seek congressional approval.
* She dismissed concerns about the awful conditions aboard Navy ships in the Persian Gulf.
* When our Sailors were forced to endure the longest sea deployments since Vietnam, she refused to help bring them home.

We need someone in Congress who will ask the hard questions, stand up to the president, and protect the men and women who protect us with their lives.

**So I’m fighting to win back one of the most flippable House seats in the country and get back to work on Capitol Hill.** This November is our chance to flip the House and elect leaders we can actually trust. Have you seen the latest out of Texas?
**The experts at VoteHub recently shifted the Texas Senate race to Lean D.**
This is a big deal. It's been more than 30 years since Texas sent a Democrat to the Senate, and in less than a month, they have the opportunity to elect James Talarico. **[So if you're ready to stake a claim in this movement and be a part of something special, please split a donation between my campaign and James Talarico before our last FEC deadline on Wednesday.](https://substack.com/redirect/362b4cfb-3c10-468d-8787-7a05fa0619d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/362b4cfb-3c10-468d-8787-7a05fa0619d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Otherwise, let me tell you why I'm supporting James.
For years, Texas seemed to be too big to win. Now, things are shifting. James is building grassroots momentum across the state, Republicans know that he has a real chance to make history and they're panicking. Right now, they're planning to spend over $200 million against James to prop up their candidate Ken Paxton, who was impeached by his own party on corruption charges.
Paxton has even resorted to making AI generated videos of James to convince voters he's someone he's not.
**So let me tell you who James Talarico is.**
He's the grandson of a Baptist preacher in South Texas who is tired of politicians corrupting our faith to protect their own power.
He understands that the war in Iran is raising gas prices for hardworking Americans, and making everything more expensive.
He is fighting back against corrupt politicians who are profiting off of corrupt policies as Texans pay the price.
He is a threat to Trump, Musk and the Republican establishment trying desperately to silence his campaign.
We have about three weeks until Election Day, and I know these final days won't be easy. James needs your support to get through the hardest stretch of this campaign and we don't have a moment to spare.
**[Please, will you split a contribution between my campaign and James Talarico before our final FEC deadline on Wednesday? Flipping the Senate requires all of us chipping in where we can, when we can.](https://substack.com/redirect/362b4cfb-3c10-468d-8787-7a05fa0619d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Roy Cooper

clean_body: We can scrap the Electoral College| | | | | | The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress,** friend: Virginia is the latest state to join the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact. This follows Minnesota and Maine last year.If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 18 states plus DC have now joined. Virginia brings 13 electoral votes after Minnesota brought 10, with Maine's 4, which now accounts for 222 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and more than 80% of what is needed to effectively make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress. No matter where I go or what role I serve in, I will always be a proud Pueblo woman. My roots here in New Mexico run 35 generations deep, and the values I was raised with have guided me from the halls of Congress to serving as the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history.
**[Now, I'm running to become the first Native American woman governor in our nation's history. With Election Day just weeks away, will you split a donation of $10 between NV Dems and my campaign to help us make history in New Mexico?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquN1aoJYYSN4wWuHwHSdnJrGBYqPU3SX3blLJAZZrqPG3XH_cE0pn74sCPAHsm2IjOy8WOQZrpGyTMmEauN9Ld6Av_Xjdt0Xhvg-fMlx9KE3OuDFvNwSoOKolZMnZogdCVufQ7TSAS3mHgYZZ3-7M9_0fnUroBFAon898hrxrF8vcP3KFdk9DHubL8CoSxuyTk25atS2LyICHF-CLr3lYgayzYw-gvj2v8j6DxI-ktER_alv2gfzQWAenvEpimnWM2Sf7VuSbpUF8KKWAWu3jdWSo1Brd5G-C9qFsM_sy-ALNFd3Kopjp0BGllzx879QdLmXsXQHKCX2iyic1JNxjoDDlNcsqtUW46wYwlpXsxMxn6t7IED0RVBPQTTeMjdW-k/4ut/-AdOSUDSRzmbHX4DlzQb6A/h1/h001.EMxJHr4WzLt47oCbmNNXq4PTiOcPtXjx7sOVykqtK1U)**

Growing up, my mother and grandmother taught me to respect the land, cherish our water, and honor the traditions passed down through generations of Pueblo families. They taught me that caring for the places we call home is also a way of caring for one another.
Those lessons stayed with me as Secretary of the Interior, where I worked to protect sacred places like Chaco Canyon and preserve our public lands for generations to come.
[ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquN1aoJYYSN4wWuHwHSdnJrGBYqPU3SX3blLJAZZrqPG3XH_cE0pn74sCPAHsm2IjOy8WOQZrpGyTMmEauN9Ld6Av_Xjdt0Xhvg-fMlx9KE3CVfI2PyrvO28N6rsy0oKJ8lVu8KTiuEPWoqxdtdZ70dS2Td5XtbQIXSzy1RCs0KL77BsIZFCb50BjIfwpNx9EbZbRv2uwOf07xtAHO_0KqjDTOVpDk43sVFdlzelECqdCkOFIKMnyMThJ9PKIJMVUAo4Qyj1wYpReS-G6ZH9Zx9B9pM5iiI6bZcThaneJjxp3XawGp1YV9PUNOYVOG4WuuxmpRaIyrx-4YrSqRM7WHspZZ7HfgfTFqtsZiEQAQySCImIBIDXhW_XhiIE0OYDIk/4ut/-AdOSUDSRzmbHX4DlzQb6A/h3/h001.xcHRV2jHFKkJHb1EcWMQT2qIiQaxxdHhXOTgWDwiyzw)

**Because protecting our land and water isn't just about honoring where we come from. It's about protecting what we leave behind for future generations.**
Here in New Mexico, our land and water are central to our communities, our cultures, and our way of life. As governor, I want to ensure our children and grandchildren inherit the same opportunities to enjoy and care for these places that generations before us have had.
That means honoring the people who have cared for these lands since time immemorial and ensuring their voices are heard in the decisions that shape our future.
[ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquN1aoJYYSN4wWuHwHSdnJrGBYqPU3SX3blLJAZZrqPG3XH_cE0pn74sCPAHsm2IjOy8WOQZrpGyTMmEauN9Ld6Av_Xjdt0Xhvg-fMlx9KE3PinXlNDWUqk0aJqnUDmZlCSl_z4IQDOPnBm5VvhYq-5YSCHbGzW0wXjyT2n-PyX-nLlJOPxicX2KeJyxiaSDvql08Htl0VjSs56QpmLKXGRZ3Ih9UkFwy4TcfcWAUSzztigvG7K2eA-nBRu1CHDZzGbhwNhCdR6zdeP5zOvnDvpxfhF8Ma7Vk_7hGktyfCwW35bXHmCKyJz6u-JVU_N8CtYPKNoAaQUT-OHAUzGqi8pK_soO-8YkcAI1U0wtSp7Dx6YUDLnG4gUbdaP_Lwe-gU/4ut/-AdOSUDSRzmbHX4DlzQb6A/h4/h001.8l16pc0IMQEBCYCKQjgyRbCZCD3VGuagXJSv6HPwTV0)

Indigenous voices are crucial in shaping the future of our communities. From protecting sacred lands and managing our precious water resources to providing education and building opportunities for our communities, Tribal Nations deserve a meaningful role in decisions that affect them. Throughout my career, I've worked to bring those voices into the rooms where decisions are made. That commitment remains central to my work in New Mexico.
**To me, that means working alongside Tribal Nations, respecting their sovereignty, and ensuring their voices are not only heard but also respected.**
_But, I can’t make that vision a reality alone, and I hope I can count on you to help._
**[With Election Day just weeks away, we have an opportunity to make history here in New Mexico. This Indigenous Peoples' Day, I'm reflecting on the land that has sustained my Pueblo ancestors for generations, and the responsibility we have to protect them for generations to come. | No matter where I go or what role I serve in, I will always be a proud Pueblo woman. My roots here in New Mexico run 35 generations deep, and the values I was raised with have guided me from the halls of Congress to serving as the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. Growing up, my mother and grandmother taught me to respect the land, cherish our water, and honor the traditions passed down through generations of Pueblo families. They taught me that caring for the places we call home is also a way of caring for one another. Those lessons stayed with me as Secretary of the Interior, where I worked to protect sacred places like Chaco Canyon and preserve our public lands for generations to come. Because protecting our land and water isn't just about honoring where we come from. It's about protecting what we leave behind for future generations. Here in New Mexico, our land and water are central to our communities, our cultures, and our way of life. As governor, I want to ensure our children and grandchildren inherit the same opportunities to enjoy and care for these places that generations before us have had. That means honoring the people who have cared for these lands since time immemorial and ensuring their voices are heard in the decisions that shape our future. Indigenous voices are crucial in shaping the future of our communities. From protecting sacred lands and managing our precious water resources to providing education and building opportunities for our communities, Tribal Nations deserve a meaningful role in decisions that affect them. Throughout my career, I've worked to bring those voices into the rooms where decisions are made. That commitment remains central to my work in New Mexico. To me, that means working alongside Tribal Nations, respecting their sovereignty, and ensuring their voices are not only heard but also respected. But, I can’t make that vision a reality alone, and I hope I can count on you to help. body:
Fighting for environmental justice on Indigenous People’s Day and every day: | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWWVho7HqpwPYCmtYWxD67cxVOSwH9LMBHgn2FU64hPBOdX76pdscTvot748uvbooHw9-pKnBQBCp77VrgrJ1bK89ApYUxn1LY95JZ8p5zASbzH7jy1LXfikGqSC3cDp4N6JHkxSAylognTmNGb2WBPKnLSVokI-gmJl5Pq7CC-hYyQHaJdZ4FspACNEi9p5xT/4ut/XsBoo9_FQhGR-X3hhwCxVA/h0/h001.BDqoEgx4PiLqqDz68aGmHL0hWJ9ho7spRsjPpudCR1A)
---
Friend, Today is Indigenous People’s Day, a reminder to honor the original stewards of this land — who are still here and fighting for environmental justice and sovereignty. I’ve worked alongside Indigenous leaders to protect our lands and water; take on corporate polluters; and push back against the Trump administration’s threats to our public lands, which are Native peoples’ ancestral lands. I recently joined a letter to Trump’s Secretary of the Interior demanding more information about his plans to expand data centers on our public lands, which would violate the federal government’s constitutional obligations to respect Tribes’ sovereignty. Tribes must be involved in — and consent to — decisions affecting their lands, waters, and communities’ well-being. On Friday, I toured a horrifying hyperscale data center in majority-Black Memphis, with environmental justice organizer and congressional candidate Justin Pearson: [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_Z1bqhAqZ-zTCXh_rlMFaqBFYN2do3hU3oMI6N9j_gIhBVlmwO_vbCKNtbK4TeP0EY5tlys9uXID5-PkHvSoG8Gu8DZaVDCQGIlZMMGljiXR3qqmIFYk6vqk4mwje6DHvZI-bYCdXP3NDpJphqwsirgygG5AgeE3v0w9yvvtRt-xrbuJvaIW1_t5Nd45RCEdXSN6pnLPOaWNhei2uwSnIzCpGvXYnfjcCkLdKvi_-PnxLFAokEXUMv8sISS9bNUQZMT8-XFfS5nkxs132jeljY3XmuCHb89nS3rX5BCe8P7XsVOYVuAbqX9YOeq-NWzB8-_1u4ETwCHmlo_Nukpy-flPNOoFFdyhP3JHHz3M2hqXfJ4X8eo6FYezgZpCVibybEfGfuSWxSg0X9JHw4yrX7K_mJnsgBuMJ14hQSMB9MfteFR1eVqVNHHDfoQt78LW7CmViEgqFtxLqq94FARpHY/4ut/XsBoo9_FQhGR-X3hhwCxVA/h1/h001.RQDz5PDZJv4UXEueo2FVSvaJ7JR5vKfbenghR4Fiwlg) Data centers pollute the land, water, air, and the bodies of living beings. They raise our utility bills and further the climate crisis. Their pollution — including intense noise pollution — harms animals that are sacred to many Tribes. They also threaten sacred places and plants, including traditional Indigenous medicines. **I never imagined that I would become one of Donald Trump’s most outspoken opponents.**

I grew up in a working-class, conservative Catholic family in El Paso, Texas. My mother was a Mexican immigrant who became an American citizen. My father was a lifelong truck driver. The Fourth of July was practically sacred in our home.

I was raised to believe in hard work, personal responsibility, service and love of country.

After September 11th, I felt called to serve. I went to work at the Pentagon, spent a year in Iraq and served our country in national-security and counterterrorism positions under both Republican and Democratic presidents.

Eventually, I was asked to serve as Vice President Mike Pence’s homeland security and counterterrorism adviser.

I sat in the Situation Room. I staffed the White House Coronavirus Task Force. I entered those rooms believing that, no matter our political differences, everyone entrusted with the security of the American people would understand that the country came first.

Then I saw what was really happening behind closed doors.

**I watched Donald Trump treat a deadly pandemic like a political and public-relations problem. I watched expertise get dismissed, the truth get bent and dedicated public servants get pushed aside because they would not place loyalty to one man above their oath to the country.**

Decisions that affected millions of American families were repeatedly reduced to one question: What was best for Donald Trump?

For a long time, I told myself that staying meant I could help. That perhaps I could prevent something worse from happening.

But eventually, I had to ask myself a much harder question:

Was I helping protect the country -- or was my presence helping legitimize something I knew was dangerous?

In 2020, I resigned from the Trump administration. Then I went public.

I was terrified.

I knew speaking out could cost me my career, my livelihood and my family’s safety. The attacks came quickly. There were threats, smears and attempts to intimidate me into silence.

But silence costs more.

So I spoke out. I supported Joe Biden. I stood on the stage at the Democratic National Convention and supported Kamala Harris. And after spending most of my life as a Republican, I eventually became a Democrat.

Not because every belief I held changed overnight. Not because I suddenly agreed with every Democrat on every issue.

I became a Democrat because there comes a moment when party loyalty becomes complicity -- and country must come first.

Now, Trump is back in the White House, the guardrails are weaker, and Republicans in Congress have repeatedly chosen obedience over oversight. MAGA is no longer merely threatening to abuse power. We are living with the consequences.

**That is why I am writing to you today on behalf of Resist Reclaim Rebuild.**

Resist Reclaim Rebuild is a group of Democratic activists working to defeat MAGA candidates in the battleground races that will determine whether Donald Trump continues to enjoy virtually unchecked power -- or whether we elect a Congress capable of standing up to him.

They understand that resistance cannot exist only in speeches, television interviews, or social media posts.

It MUST reach the ballot box.

It MUST be organized.

And it MUST be focused on the races where a relatively small number of votes could mean the difference between a MAGA rubber stamp and a real check on Donald Trump’s power.

[**So, I'm asking personally: Will you donate $10, $25 or whatever you can afford today to help Resist Reclaim Rebuild defeat MAGA in the battleground races that matter most?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141249867/652939873/-323302678?refcode=261012_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzNmZmFmZGQtNTFjNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Dug82OYBWDLH1iMP8oAhh9V2RHaaw9HUVKHKGzjvaDU=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141249868/652939874/949025562?refcode=261012_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzNmZmFmZGQtNTFjNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Dug82OYBWDLH1iMP8oAhh9V2RHaaw9HUVKHKGzjvaDU=)

MAGA wants us exhausted. They want every new outrage to make us feel a little more powerless. They want us to believe that one person speaking out, casting a ballot or making a contribution cannot possibly change anything.

I learned the opposite.

I learned that courage is contagious.

Control of Congress could come down to only a handful of seats. Your contribution can help elect Democrats who will defend our Constitution, demand accountability and finally place a meaningful check on Trump’s unfettered power.

Please help Resist Reclaim Rebuild fight for those victories today.

Eventually, I was asked to serve as Vice President Mike Pence’s homeland security and counterterrorism adviser. I sat in the Situation Room. I staffed the White House Coronavirus Task Force. I entered those rooms believing that, no matter our political differences, everyone entrusted with the security of the American people would understand that the country came first. Then I saw what was really happening behind closed doors. I watched Donald Trump treat a deadly pandemic like a political and public-relations problem. I watched expertise get dismissed, the truth get bent and dedicated public servants get pushed aside because they would not place loyalty to one man above their oath to the country. Decisions that affected millions of American families were repeatedly reduced to one question: What was best for Donald Trump? For a long time, I told myself that staying meant I could help. That perhaps I could prevent something worse from happening. But eventually, I had to ask myself a much harder question: Was I helping protect the country -- or was my presence helping legitimize something I knew was dangerous? In 2020, I resigned from the Trump administration. Then I went public. I was terrified. I knew speaking out could cost me my career, my livelihood and my family’s safety. The attacks came quickly. There were threats, smears and attempts to intimidate me into silence. But silence costs more. So I spoke out. I supported Joe Biden. I stood on the stage at the Democratic National Convention and supported Kamala Harris. And after spending most of my life as a Republican, I eventually became a Democrat. Not because every belief I held changed overnight. Not because I suddenly agreed with every Democrat on every issue. I became a Democrat because there comes a moment when party loyalty becomes complicity -- and country must come first. Now, Trump is back in the White House, the guardrails are weaker, and Republicans in Congress have repeatedly chosen obedience over oversight. MAGA is no longer merely threatening to abuse power. We are living with the consequences. That is why I am writing to you today on behalf of Resist Reclaim Rebuild. Resist Reclaim Rebuild is a group of Democratic activists working to defeat MAGA candidates in the battleground races that will determine whether Donald Trump continues to enjoy virtually unchecked power -- or whether we elect a Congress capable of standing up to him. They understand that resistance cannot exist only in speeches, television interviews, or social media posts. It MUST reach the ballot box. It MUST be organized. And it MUST be focused on the races where a relatively small number of votes could mean the difference between a MAGA rubber stamp and a real check on Donald Trump’s power. = | | | = MAGA wants us exhausted. They want every new outrage to make us feel a little more powerless. They want us to believe that one person speaking out, casting a ballot or making a contribution cannot possibly change anything. I learned the opposite. I learned that courage is contagious. Control of Congress could come down to only a handful of seats. Your contribution can help elect Democrats who will defend our Constitution, demand accountability and finally place a meaningful check on Trump’s unfettered power. Please help Resist Reclaim Rebuild fight for those victories today. = Stay informed. Stay compassionate. Stay hopeful. But above all, refuse to be silent. Olivia Troye | | | | Resist Reclaim Rebuild is an organization committed to helping Democrats win up and down the ballot, nationwide. **
### FORMER LAWLER VOTER SUPPORTING CAIT CONLEY FOR CONGRESS
**********************OSSINING, NY –** After previously voting for Mike Lawler, Rockland County resident Mike Monroe [is supporting Cait Conley for Congress](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMfNorqDKWycinqM6AXOEy16sbVdsGbjTs43tChS6zy1e2bWKcgtSZQAH2HMFEiMcZtra2yDcbKssgGVUf584PHQtaRoGjIva7WF7SJXoRkp1ys6CEpVlG5GDmpnQ6ftyr_7GN_yh2ZHo31lPCMlBWJ-KLP67Lv6QUIBvsZVLkUFY3tqyFdSQZorPknTcRW2kFhgClAq11NDnsh4EhDGuHVF38hj7uIUySBR4nRri0Ia5ftwWm5EJaSMpbCuzBMZ0uuKie2KOZto6I7PdtXa-acUh-FBNhCLVqS5gk9xqndwTGXV2gkYjZm8sSOe-kv8tmqfjVzEDDrzBBmJIG6zTLeG9-tTYwmsqxTwuAxf2DFHHJwIrk-sJAQ915STkC17A8yrUWmUFjFoNMvHd13ci9r_8nqh5NsAzC0hgo8eMh6mJXqhqrjJySlmyfcVlj2irA5zYJnoH2JwFB9M5NOMGQ54O5o7EQYAEP15uTHaSTH2Lat4e-B1DVoZTsYgw2fRn0dV6fiPpuJRjipTDVW-YeNLIcsDxyNr3xcIB4FwCS91qn4Ak2Sfnspakigk5FlW2IQ/4ut/scFUBSGfTpGv52SbTFzcqw/h0/h001.JrifNKGiRDLK1mmJZCJconVBDLTfeIf5hp6ZXLb4kKM) in New York’s 17th District. The Air Force veteran, husband, and father cites Lawler’s [100% voting record with Donald Trump](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.fYwBmNOg9T7TSqRCKjNSzXtCMKHcN2ul7HRUCTRtim_x0IdTp9CfZkNXZLwKh8zsstuAxGyVEtHg4ClKmndpZ1Qz3XZaQ_EDq3htLOckpEBXOEZXVV_0gkjtZx1Z-TCitchnquY_OvwXFg3E7vUntMnq0bD_DP_IJ1Yr5CQFPBMhl-SGC3zEHYDmvXDHzLsvQ_65uzA-uA5_cQhANEze_iPFdvCzlG4vWxE_nJ5KP4frQL_4RsLXVluZPrK_3ozzIYw04PyKZnWUZHn0nIuTMDiRZM0bb0e6UQdPi-cW-AuBiEs9JOnO0zhEhlmRpUk6egs2j-EJw9JoxYDMVP5-hg/4ut/scFUBSGfTpGv52SbTFzcqw/h1/h001.on13enxuk5P2WBCQkk0wjTOSVoo_O4UcIk0tf7PZEAU), inability to stand up to party leaders, and failure to deliver on lowering costs as broken promises and reasons for losing his support. _“At the end of the day, actions have consequences. Mike Lawler’s allegiance to Donald Trump has raised my cost-of-living, and cost him my vote.”_ Monroe is voting for Cait Conley because her working-class roots and 16 years of service to our country give him faith that she will take on her own party when needed and deliver the affordable future the Hudson Valley deserves. _“Cait has vowed to take on corruption so politicians can’t keep lining their pockets at the taxpayers’ expense. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3442%2E259176%2ENrPNLi) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3442%2E259176%2ENrPNLi)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18416?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.12_DJones-Why-Alabama_B3_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON&t=4&akid=3442%2E259176%2ENrPNLi) Folks,

If there’s one thing that proves to me we are going to win the Alabama governor’s election, it’s the range of folks who have come out to our last few town halls.

We’ve had Democrats, Republicans, independents, and plenty of folks who do not fit neatly into any political party. We may disagree on some things, but we all agree that Alabama deserves a governor who works for Alabamians, actually _lives_ in Alabama, and will not treat our government like some get-rich-quick scheme.

**We are changing Alabama.** I strongly believe that as we get the word out about this campaign, Alabamians from every political stripe will continue to join us. With your support, we’ve made great progress, but there’s still a lot of work to be done.

The truth is, the people who are attending our town halls are already deeply engaged in this election. But hundreds of thousands of Alabamians do not follow state politics closely, or even at all. Many may not even know that we have a competitive election for governor for the first time in 20 years.

If we’re going to win this election, we have to reach those folks in their homes and show them what this campaign stands for: making life just a bit easier for ordinary Alabamians, protecting our rural hospitals and funding our schools, abolishing our grocery tax, launching a state lottery, and building a state government that answers to the people of Alabama.

Now, if we were trying to do that in Tommy Tuberville’s home state of Florida, we would have a problem. **Thankfully, Alabama is one of the best states in the country to run a TV ad program.** It costs nearly _five times_ as much to run political ads in Florida, much less in super expensive TV markets like Atlanta or New York City.

I know you are getting flooded with fundraising requests right now from people running for office all across the country. **The truth is an investment in our campaign for governor goes further than just about anywhere else.** A contribution that would barely make a dent in Georgia or Florida can help us reach thousands of voters right here in Alabama.

body:
Johnson's proposal restores merit, protects current recipients, and creates permanent funding without raising taxes

# **Johnson Unveils Three-Part Plan to Save Nevada’s Millennium Scholarship**
---
| |
### _Proposal restores merit, protects current recipients, and creates permanent funding without raising taxes_
---
| | **Las Vegas, NV —** Nevada State Treasurer candidate Drew Johnson today released a three-part plan to save Nevada’s Governor Guinn Millennium Scholarship program. Johnson’s plan reforms future eligibility, protects students already counting on the program, and dedicates a portion of residual unclaimed-property revenue to a permanent scholarship endowment.
The Governor Guinn Millennium Scholarship provides eligible Nevada high school graduates up to $10,000 in tuition assistance to attend qualifying Nevada colleges and universities, including the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, the University of Nevada, Reno, and the state’s community colleges.
About $38 million in Millennium Scholarship funds are awarded in a typical year. But the scholarship fund is expected to fall to approximately $21.1 million by the end of FY2027. That insolvency will strip the scholarship from 10,600 current students.
By 2028, the program will be bankrupt, unable to pay for any scholarships because of incompetence and mismanagement by the program’s director and Johnson’s opponent for State Treasurer, Tya Mathis-Coleman.
“The Millennium Scholarship is one of Nevada’s best ideas, but its survival cannot depend on taxpayer bailouts,” Johnson said. “We can honor our promise to current students, restore the scholarship as a meaningful merit award, and build a financial structure that can support it for generations.”
Johnson’s plan to save the Governor Guinn Millennium Scholarship program has three parts:
1. **Restore merit.** Beginning with the 2028-29 graduating class, eligibility would generally go to students in the top 20 percent of each qualifying Nevada high school class who complete the required core curriculum and earn at least a 3.0 unweighted core GPA. Scholarship recipients would then need to maintain a 3.0 college GPA to remain eligible.
The plan would include fair, objective alternatives for homeschool students and other students who do not receive a traditional class ranking.

2. **Protect current students and set reasonable limits.** Students who have already qualified would be grandfathered. Future recipients would have four years, rather than six, to use the scholarship, with a limit of eight semesters or 120 credits, while keeping the current $10,000 lifetime cap and reasonable exceptions for military service, disability, and medical hardship.

3. **Build permanent funding.** Nevada would keep the existing tobacco-settlement funding and current $7.6 million annual unclaimed-property transfer. After valid owner claims, program costs, and other statutory obligations are satisfied, 25 percent of the remaining unclaimed-property money that would otherwise automatically be swept into the General Fund would instead support the Millennium Scholarship.

During the transition, that revenue would help stabilize the program, ensuring existing recipients continue to receive their scholarships. Once the program is financially stable, excess revenue would be invested in a permanent Millennium Scholarship endowment, creating an increasingly reliable source of investment income to help fund scholarships for future generations.
The plan would not raise taxes, and all unclaimed property funds would remain fully available for their rightful owners to claim at any time.
Johnson contrasted his proposal with the record and approach of his opponent, Mathis-Coleman.
“Tya Mathis-Coleman has bungled the Millennium Scholarship for 6 years. Her gross mismanagement has left tens of thousands of Nevada’s most promising students wondering if they’ll receive the scholarships they were counting on,” Johnson said. “She has had plenty of time to produce a serious, long-term solution, and we still don’t have one.”
Mathis-Coleman said she would attempt to save the scholarship by asking taxpayers to fund additional bailouts and trying to shake down private businesses to support the scholarship.
“Another taxpayer bailout might keep Millennium alive for a few more years. A few corporate donations might help around the edges. But neither is a mature, responsible solution that fixes the fundamental problem: the scholarship is promising more money than its recurring revenues can sustain,” Johnson said.
“As Treasurer, I will protect the Millennium Scholarship for current students, ensure it is reserved for Nevada’s best and brightest students, and put it on a financial foundation built to last for generations — all without asking Nevada’s already struggling taxpayers to foot the bill.”
Drew Johnson is the Republican nominee for Nevada State Treasurer. He has spent his career in government finance and as a government watchdog exposing waste, fraud, and abuse and fighting to save taxpayers billions of dollars. He intends to continue fighting to protect taxpayers as Nevada’s Treasurer.
For more information about Drew Johnson and his campaign for Nevada State Treasurer, visit [**DrewForNevada.com**](https://us.list-manage.com/14a7qjaUT9U?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d).

Dear Patriot, I’m sounding the alarm. Radical Kathy Hochul has officially BANNED all local police cooperation with ICE agents – and this is just a taste of the nightmare she has in store for all of us in New York if she wins re-election on November 3rd. **[I need your urgent help to DEFEAT KATHY HOCHUL. ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjcsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA3tOBfPFd3iyMkJfy8a0yKuDo4_7Wx6EOtPLau4BdMmgoVEy05BbApIcOh2OUSwHZJ82_-OTS3Wgvdms4mP-T7UDHa18QmjMITDHl6Hm)** With just over one month to go until Election Day, Hochul’s anti-ICE “political stunt” is costing New Yorkers their lives. In fact, according to DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin, **13,000** individuals since January 20th have been released into our communities in New York after ICE tried to put detainers on them. These are murderers, rapists, pedophiles, and drug traffickers that Kathy Hochul released from custody and sent across New York. Instead of going after the criminals and illegals who are terrorizing us... ... Hochul is going after the police. It’s wrong. And our one chance to stop her is on November 3rd. **That’s why my campaign team is urgently gearing up to launch a massive TV ad buy exposing Hochul’s lawless, pro-criminal agenda, and I need your help to make it happen.** In fact, I need to raise **$123,200** to get this ad on the air. **Will you send a $25 campaign contribution today to help me raise the money I need to launch this ad statewide? ** Remember, contributions up to $250 will be eligible for a 600% match, which means you can help me raise the funds I need for this ad 6x faster! I hate to be so direct, but time is running out, and every New York voter needs to know that Hochul puts the wants of criminals and illegals above the safety of their family. Kathy Hochul has gone so far down the path of socialism that she’s even bragging about putting _Illegals First_ and _New Yorkers Last_ ... ?
---
---
Hochul is a political snake. I’ll let her own words speak for themselves:
---
Kathy Hochul in 2024: **“Someone breaks the law, I’ll be the first one to call up ICE and say, ‘get them out of here.’”** Kathy Hochul in 2026: **“I wish [ICE] would just disband... this is a rogue policing state that is wreaking havoc.”**
---
She doesn’t believe in anything she pushes. She will simply do and say _whatever it_ _takes_ to get power... **And the terrifying reality is that right now in New York, that means supporting lawless socialism.** I know you agree that we cannot give her another four years as governor. She will utterly destroy New York. But when I defeat her, I will repeal sanctuary state mandates, support law enforcement at every level, restore order in our prison system, and give our frontline heroes the support they deserve. This is exactly what New York needs, but it’s going to be the fight of a lifetime to win this race. **Will you help me defeat radical Kathy Hochul by helping me launch a final massive TV ad buy across the state to expose her lawless, pro-criminal agenda?** **Will you help me raise the $123,200 I need to get this TV ad on the air? ** With just over one month left until Election Day, TV ads are the #1 way I can reach millions of New York voters. Of course, New York has one of the most expensive media markets in America, which is why this ad is going to cost me $123,200. [**So if you could give a larger contribution today, say $50, $100, or more, it will help me raise what I need in no time at all.** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjcsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA3tOBfPGwts1VoiiEr9y7vsEIZxzcbMqX-69925BqoVxXFpd7DFS1R7ZM_nrNnwdWx4QfTT-sFg8vbs_DOmUmxjfT2BssdvnWQH7511_) _Don’t forget that your contribution up to $250 will be eligible for a 6x match!_ All I ask is that you hurry. That will ensure I get this ad on the air before Election Day. Thank you for standing with me – and thank you for hurrying!
---
For New York, Bruce Blakeman
---
P.S. It’s no wonder that radical Kathy Hochul has officially banned all police cooperation with ICE. She endorsed Communist Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who has supported defunding the police and abolishing ICE for years. This is just a taste of what Kathy Hochul plans to do to New York if she’s given another four years in Albany to wreak havoc. **We’ve got no choice but to defeat her on November 3****rd****!** I need to get an urgent new TV ad on the air statewide to make sure that every voter knows Hochul puts _Criminals and Illegals First_ and _New Yorkers Last_. **Will you send your $25 or more contribution to help me raise the $123,200 I need to get this ad on the air? Omar.

Peter,
Donald Trump’s fascism and abuse of power has now come to my literal front
door.

This morning, DHS agents raided and searched my home in the DC area as the
latest step in their ludicrous, partisan investigation into my immigration
status.

I have been in Trump’s crosshairs for years, but now he is escalating in a
desperate attempt to drag me and the entire progressive movement down
ahead of the midterms.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261012-2-io.8i-tT3&refcode=em20261012-38347&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38347%2E1203867%2E36Hom5 ]This is a critical moment for our democracy, and we must be decisive.
Please, stand by me and our movement today by rushing a contribution,
split between me and Justice Democrats, to help me fight back in the face
of Trump’s abuse of power >>

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261012-2-io.8i-tT3&refcode=em20261012-38347&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38347%2E1203867%2E36Hom5 ]RUSH A DONATION

It’s no accident that this raid comes three weeks before an election where
I’m on the ballot.

This is part of the fascist playbook to rile up Trump’s die-hard
supporters and give them a big distraction in advance of the midterms.
With this obviously political investigation, Trump is telling his voters:
"Ignore the price of gas, ignore the war in Iran, ignore that you’re
losing your healthcare — we want you to get angry about this instead.”

Throughout his presidency, Trump has weaponized the DOJ to target his
political opponents, manufacturing charges that have been roundly
dismissed by court after court. And I’m not even the first member of
Congress to be targeted. The point is to waste everyone’s time and
resources, and generate negative headlines for his opponents.

I will repeat what I have long said: This is a ludicrous investigation,
and Trump’s escalation is only further proof that he is willing to use the
power of the federal government to try to intimidate and silence anyone
who stands up to him. It’s up to us to make sure it doesn’t work.

In just a few weeks we can strike a major blow at Trump’s fascist agenda
and end this era of authoritarianism by taking Congress back from MAGA.
Today, as I stand in the breach of Trump’s endless attacks and immense
power to do harm, I’m asking for your support:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261012-2-io.8i-tT3&refcode=em20261012-38347&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1005&akid=38347%2E1203867%2E36Hom5 ]Please, stand with me today by splitting a generous donation between me
and Justice Democrats. Your donation will help me not only fight back
against this incredible abuse of power, but continue to organize our
movement for democracy, peace, and affordability ahead of what is shaping
up to be one of the most important elections of our lives.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261012-2-io.8i-tT3&refcode=em20261012-38347&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1024&akid=38347%2E1203867%2E36Hom5 ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

body:
You’re invited to tonight's Take Back The House virtual phone bank with Congressman Derek Tran and Red-to-Blue candidate for CA-48 Marni von

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/derektranforcongress/2026-oct-12-phone-bank-blast-6433237?e=fa48019594)
---
| | | | |
---
| | Dear Supporter,
You’re invited to tonight’s _**Take Back The House**_ virtual phone bank with Congressman Derek Tran and Red-to-Blue candidate for CA-48 Marni von Wilpert!
**WHEN:** Monday, October 12 5 - 7 p.m. PST**WHERE:** Virtual**RSVP:**[**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/gZpsXfLrsc4?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4)
To receive your virtual meeting link, phone bank training, and hear from Marni on our plan to take back the House, please RSVP via the link above. I hope to see you there!
Sincerely,Congressman Derek Tran
---
| | ###
_The son of refugees who worked hard and sacrificed for the American Dream, Congressman Derek Tran joined the Army at 18 to give back to the country that has given him so much. Wanting to continue his career in public service, he ran in California's 45th district to put people ahead of politics and protect democracy, and won. Now, he's running again to ensure everyone no matter what neighborhood they come from has the opportunity to succeed without fear of their freedoms being taken away._
_California’s 45th Congressional District remains one of the most contested battleground races in the country. Last cycle, Derek Tran flipped the seat by just over 600 votes (a 0.2% margin) in the second-closest and most expensive House race ($46 million spent) in the country. A majority-minority district, the District has the third largest AAPI population (41%) of any Congressional District, is 28% Latino, and is home to the largest Vietnamese community in the country. Following Proposition 50, this district brings in over 15,000 new Hispanic voters and over 7,000 new Vietnamese voters, and has a DPI of 52.8%. It includes all or part of the cities of Garden Grove, Westminster, Fountain Valley, Cerritos, Buena Park, Placentia, Hawaiian Gardens, Cypress, Artesia, Los Alamitos, La Palma, Norwalk, Stanton, Lakewood, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, and Fullerton, as well as the unincorporated community of Midway City._
_Use of Derek Tran's military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Dept. of Defense or U.S. Army._

About half of Maine households heat with fuel oil (basically the second cousin of diesel), and Maine burns more residential heating oil per person than any other state, according to the Maine Department of Energy Resources. When diesel spikes, Mainers feel it in the truck, on the boat, and in the basement.
So you'd expect a Maine senator to cheer anything that promises cheaper diesel. But U.S. Sen. Susan Collins isn't cheering an idea from President Donald Trump that would allow Russia to evade sanctions and export diesel to the U.S.
Subscribe to The Robinson Report: We won't raise your oil prices.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..w-nbkCprg074aMjmw-LgAnBSOWVCZ9nlN72mEwWuN2k?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=219908682)
On Friday, President Donald Trump announced on social media that he'd struck a deal with Russian dictator Vladimir Putin over the phone. According to Trump, Russia will supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel immediately, then 500,000 tons in November, then 1 million tons "immediately thereafter," then another 3 million tons "within a short period of time."
Here's Collins, in a statement from her office:
> "I oppose President Trump's decision to lift sanctions on the purchase of diesel from Russia. I was a cosponsor of the Russian sanctions law, which the President recently signed but is now not following."
Translation: Collins knows that expensive heating oil will become an economic problem for Mainers -- and therefore a potential political problem for her -- but she's placing national policy ahead of a short-term deal with a hostile foreign power.
Collins joined Sens. Lisa Murkowski (R-Ak.), Thom Tillis (R-N.C.), John Curtis (R-Utah), Jeanne Shaheen (D-N.H.), the ranking member on Senate Foreign Relations, and Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.) on a joint statement Sunday.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2246936&post_id=219908682&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjE5OTA4NjgyLCJpYXQiOjE3OTE4MjE4NzcsImV4cCI6MTc5NDQxMzg3NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTIyNDY5MzYiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.BhN-AmKY1FyA4AejmzieZd8VgviXB9KY7rTwvUivBBQ)
The six pointed out that Congress banned Russian energy imports in 2022 to keep American dollars from bankrolling Putin's war on Ukraine, and that the administration never consulted Congress or submitted the justification the statute requires.
"President Trump's decision to allow Russian diesel imports to the U.S. runs directly counter to that law," they wrote. "The United States should not provide Putin with a financial lifeline while Russia continues to kill Ukrainian civilians. The Administration must immediately reverse course."
A few weeks ago, Congress passed legislation directing Trump to slap substantial tariffs on the top importers of Russian oil and natural gas. The whole point was to choke off the money Putin uses to fund the war.
In last week's debate, Democrat candidate Troy Jackson, who repladed Graham Platner as the Senate nominee earlier this year, blamed the Iran war for Maine's electric bills, until Collins asked why New Hampshire's bills aren't just as bad. Trump, meanwhile, has taken to blaming Ukraine for record U.S. diesel prices.
Residential use of #2 home heating oil has averaged 78-80 million barrels per year, according to recent federal numbers. Under the terms of Trump's proposed deal with Putin, Russia would sell 35-36 million barrels into the U.S. and global markets.
