clean_body: | | | = | | On Friday, I visited the Macadam ICE facility alongside my fellow members of Congress to conduct oversight and get answers about what is happening inside. We’ve heard very concerning reports that attorneys are being turned away and prevented from meeting with their clients. Meanwhile, the number of detentions is rapidly escalating, and people are being disappeared; moved past the processing facility in Portland, directly to the NW Detention Facility or other facilities outside of the state very quickly. This facility should be a place where people detained in Oregon receive due process, not one where their rights are denied. Every person in this country has a constitutional right to due process and the right to an attorney. These are fundamental protections for everyone, regardless of immigration status. As a physician and a member of Congress, I believe our government has a responsibility to treat people with dignity and respect their basic rights. We cannot look away when those rights are being denied. Oversight means demanding answers, confronting abuses, and making sure the government is held accountable. I will keep pressing for answers about what is happening with arrests being made by masked, unidentified agents in our community, how due process is being denied inside the Macadam facility, and I will keep showing up to hold our government accountable. | | | | | | Everyone deserves to have their rights respected. No exceptions. Keep the pressure on, Dr. Maxine Dexter | | | | | = | | Maxine Dexter is a critical care physician with decades of experience using facts and following science to help her patients. # [Bessent ends Warren letter with "Happy Indigenous Peoples' Day"](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent **[handwrote](https://substack.com/redirect/187da648-6152-467d-8efb-31a75dc5625b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a mocking "Happy Indigenous People's Day" close on his reply to Sen. ---|---|---
* **Prolific correspondence** : The response noted Warren has sent more than 100 letters to the department in the past 21 months.

* **Policy contrast** : He described her as a cheerleader for Biden-era spending as rates climbed from near zero and inflation hit multi-decade highs, while highlighting her support for large tax increases.
* **Heritage reference** : The note followed her Oct. 7 request for answers by Oct. 21 and alluded to long-standing controversy over her ancestry claims.

# [Micron slides as China's CXMT touts denser 4F2 memory](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Stock reaction** : Micron and SK Hynix dropped around 2% while Samsung fell 4% amid the broader South Korean selloff.
* **CXMT announcement** : President Cao Kanyu detailed the advance at a Shanghai industry event over the weekend, targeting higher density for servers.
* **Design edge** : The 4F2 structure aims to pack more cells than the industry's 6F2 standard, with competitors also pursuing it.
* **Micron context** : Shares remain about 16% below their June all-time high following strong September results.

# [Broadcom and Intel CEOs say capital is AI's next bottleneck](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[Broadcom's Hock Tan and Intel's Lip-Bu Tan](https://substack.com/redirect/e21a4b3d-b643-4090-afb0-3ef1be1f5d81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** warned at a Singapore conference that **[financing constraints](https://substack.com/redirect/9012c38e-7c81-4d90-85c4-5c47e7da0267?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** may now limit AI expansion more than chip, memory or power shortages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Capital over hardware** : Hock Tan said capital could become the biggest constraint, even as prior bottlenecks have been overcome.
* **Easing timelines** : Memory shortages might resolve within a year, wafer constraints by 2028 or 2029, and power availability improve with new builds.
* **Demand outlook** : Both see compute demand exceeding supply through 2029 and possibly 2030, with no major slowdown in the next two to three years.
* **ROI pressure** : Lip-Bu Tan stressed that companies will need to show returns on heavy AI investment as the cost of capital rises.

# [European gas nears multi-year highs despite Citi easing call](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Dutch TTF futures trade near 83 euros per megawatt-hour, the highest since early 2023, as **[Europe heads into winter](https://substack.com/redirect/9a246077-d2db-4123-9188-53d6474ee752?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** without Qatari LNG even while Citi sees the supply squeeze easing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Storage levels** : Facilities stood over 73% full on Oct. 7, better than earlier forecasts of missing 70% but still well below the roughly 90% 15-year average.
* **Easing factors** : Citi's Maggie Xueting Lin cited industrial demand down 8% year-over-year in September and nearly 30% below pre-2022 levels, plus warm weather and potential Ukrainian re-exports.
* **Bearish forecast** : Lin holds a fourth-quarter base case of 56 euros, pointing to faster-than-expected injections.
* **Prior pressure** : Goldman had earlier said prices near 100 euros might be needed to free Asian cargoes for Europe.

# [Canadian ransomware negotiator arrested in FBI data probe](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A 54-year-old Canadian cybersecurity executive who negotiates ransomware payments was arrested in the Philadelphia area **[on federal extortion-related charges](https://substack.com/redirect/33491f23-a35e-4794-a6db-c558ba426090?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the FBI investigates the ShinyHunters group.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Charges filed** : Edward Dubrovsky faces conspiracy to threaten the confidentiality of information to extort money and interference with commerce; the case is sealed and headed to Texas.
* **Group link** : The arrest comes during a probe of ShinyHunters, which claimed data on nearly every FBI employee including via the jobs website.
* **Professional role** : Dubrovsky has specialized in cyber-extortion negotiations for firms such as CyberSteward.
* **Detention status** : He is held at the Federal Detention Center in Philadelphia pending further proceedings.

# [Halloween candy prices jump 8.1% ahead of $13.5 billion season](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Candy and chewing gum prices rose 8.1% in August from a year earlier, more than double overall inflation, as **[Americans prepare to spend $4.1 billion on treats](https://substack.com/redirect/107128fe-4d8d-4414-a37d-00bf8af27add?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** this Halloween.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e84f7da-6640-4933-b00d-c18ff9f17ff3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Total spending** : The National Retail Federation projects overall Halloween outlays of $13.5 billion, up from $13.1 billion last year.
* **Per-person average** : Shoppers expect to spend $115.14 each, little changed from $114.45.
* **Survey details** : The figures come from a Prosper Insights poll of 7,889 consumers conducted in early September.
* **Priority holds** : Consumers continue to treat the holiday as a spending priority while seeking affordability through comparison shopping and coupons.

Heritage reference : The note followed her Oct. 7 request for answers by Oct. 21 and alluded to long-standing controversy over her ancestry claims. America PAC turnout : Over $76 million went to his group to build canvassing operations active in seven Senate battlegrounds and nearly three dozen House races. Cycle totals higher : Giving this cycle already reaches about $366 million, exceeding the roughly $290 million he spent in the 2024 presidential race. CXMT announcement : President Cao Kanyu detailed the advance at a Shanghai industry event over the weekend, targeting higher density for servers. Design edge : The 4F2 structure aims to pack more cells than the industry's 6F2 standard, with competitors also pursuing it. Bearish forecast : Lin holds a fourth-quarter base case of 56 euros, pointing to faster-than-expected injections. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Because health care is a human right.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261012-6825-footer&t=1&akid=6825%2E420207%2EUbPAFR)
Peter,
**A new poll from the _Wall Street Journal_ shows 59% of Americans support passing Medicare for All:**
[****](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261012.QgQQA1&refcode=em20261012-6825&amount=3&t=2&akid=6825%2E420207%2EUbPAFR)
This is right in line with our recent independent MFA polling showing 94% of Democrats, 60% of Independents, and 1 in 5 Republicans support Medicare For All.
But despite majority support for the only policy that will _actually_ end medical financial stress and put patients over profits, Trump just announced a short-sighted plan to spend $2 billion sending one-time $90 checks to Medicare enrollees.
And in classic Trump fashion, less than one-third of Medicare recipients are even eligible for this payment. The move also doesn’t address the root causes of rising health care costs: Big Pharma and insurance companies putting profits over people.
This is one of the Trump administration’s many desperate last-minute attempts to hold onto power — but it’s not going to work. Trump’s approval ratings are floundering, and he’s grasping at straws to stay in control.
**Medicare for All is increasingly popular — Trump and MAGA are not.**
I have introduced Medicare for All legislation into every session of Congress, and I will continue to do so until we can guarantee that every single person is guaranteed the health care that they need.
People are clamoring for change — they want childcare, affordable housing, and reduced health care costs. They want this administration held accountable for its corruption. They want politicians and systems that work for them, not the interests of billionaires and giant corporations.
[**Peter, if you’re with me, can you chip in $3 today so we can continue working hard to pass Medicare for All?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261012.QgQQA1&refcode=em20261012-6825&amount=3&t=3&akid=6825%2E420207%2EUbPAFR)

In solidarity,
Pramila

I know this district like the back of my hand. I’ve spent years working alongside the hardworking families of Osceola, Orange, and Polk counties. I’ve delivered key projects for the Heartland and the Coast. I’ve stood with our local small businesses, fought for lower costs and affordable healthcare, protected our local environment, had our farmers’ backs, and brought critical investments back home to Central Florida.

**I know what matters to our neighbors because I live it every day. I know how to talk to our voters, build strong coalitions, and deliver real results.**

But make no mistake: _**this is going to be one of the toughest fights of my political career.**_

name: Vivek R.
subject: Folks may think this is “taboo” or “too controversial”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek Ramaswamy and Rob McColley for Ohio
body:
TRUTH IS: Socialism has failed everywhere it’s been tried.

| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._bqyzOherp43GCFw)
---
Let me tell you something up front:
[I’m not a career politician. I don’t have all the answers – no one does. ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
What I DO HAVE, though, is the knowledge and understanding to determine the good ideas from the bad, what doesn’t work and why. Too many young people nowadays think “capitalism” is a dirty word.
They’ve been told that it’s a system that only benefits the rich and powerful – that socialism is the way of the future. It’s what Bernie Sanders, AOC, and Zohran Mamdani preach to their loyal followers.
But I’ll say one thing: If that’s coming from them, don’t just question it, reject it outright. It’s a calculated lie.
TRUTH IS: [Socialism has failed everywhere it’s been tried. It’s a system that stifles innovation, discourages hard work, and creates dependency on government handouts.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
We need to do better than that.
I said this recently on Fox and Friends: Capitalism is the best system known to man. It lifts people out of poverty and rewards hard work, innovation, and entrepreneurship – and it's what made America the greatest country on earth.
That shouldn’t be a taboo thought or controversial opinion.

subject: We knew it:
body:
President Trump has set his sights on NC.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&source=&t=1&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT) | | | |
---
Peter,
When President Trump posted a couple of late-night tirades on Truth Social earlier this year attacking Roy, **we knew we were in for a long race.**
When Trump’s attack dog, Stephen Miller, went on Fox News to spread misinformation about Roy and this election, **we knew we were getting to them.**
When Trump came to North Carolina to rally for our opponent, Michael Whatley, and launch character smear after character smear against Roy, **we knew they were nervous.**
When Vice President Vance followed up with ANOTHER rally here five days later, **we knew they were desperate.**
North Carolina is the best chance for Democrats to flip a GOP-held Senate seat in the country, but we can’t fight back against these attacks and win without your urgent support. [**_Please chip in._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&amount=5&t=8&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT)
There are a lot of important Senate races happening this year, but Trump knows that if Republicans win in NC, they’ll block our shot at taking back the majority. It won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If Whatley wins here, that’s the entire ball game. The GOP will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
**The final FEC deadline of this election is right around the corner, and we’re falling behind on our goal. If we miss this goal, it’ll make it much harder to reach the voters we need to win – and this is a race we just can’t afford to lose.**
[**_Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 or more right now to help us defeat Trump and the GOP in North Carolina, flip this crucial seat and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&amount=5&t=9&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT)

Republicans have a massive fundraising advantage heading into these final weeks (as in hundreds of millions of dollars!), and outside groups are pouring dark money into key races all across the country. _This Wednesday, October 14th, is our very last FEC filing deadline before the midterms. After midnight, every federal campaign files a public fundraising report – and once they’re public, my MAGA opponent, national Republicans, and even those deep-pocketed groups will all read to see how we stack up._ I want to file a strong report – one that shows our deep grassroots support, a campaign built from the ground up, and the resources to win in November. What I don't want is a weak report – one that creates doubt for people who may have been sitting on the fence, and opens up space for our opponent to push even harder and pour money into the race. We cannot let that happen. **My team and I set a goal of raising another $12,000 online by Wednesday. That’s an ambitious goal, but I really believe that by working together, this team can get there. **

| | Last month I was in Houston campaigning for Democrats up and down the ballot; I heard the same thing from Asian American voters over and over: **"We don't feel like anyone is listening."** In 2024, Asian American voters shifted toward Trump by nearly ten points compared to 2020. It happened in swing states Democrats needed to win. It happened in my home state of New Jersey. And a lot of it happened because nobody showed up to ask for their vote. **A new poll from APIA Vote found that 42% of Asian and Pacific Islander voters were never contacted by a single Democratic organization in the last year.** That is a failure, and _it's one we can fix._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141263505/652979610/-1197072038?refcode=2026-10-12-aare&recurring=&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=09c5224d-69c6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOWM1MjI0ZC02OWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DWpj77A9zr8UuB-eLp73NYmxyYcAVq74APZCREB9jw8=) When I sat down with families, small business owners and community leaders in Houston, nobody asked me about a special agenda. They asked about what everyone asks about: the cost of housing, the cost of healthcare, and how to keep a small business afloat when everything keeps getting more expensive. We're not a special interest group. We want a seat at the table for the really big things, like the economy, healthcare and affordability. **Democrats should be fighting for every one of those votes.** That's why I'm taking this on the road. Houston was just the start. I'm headed to North Carolina, New Hampshire and more states across the Senate map, because in race after race, Asian American voters can be the difference between a win and a loss. [**Will you pitch in $14 right now to help us reach the voters Democrats have overlooked for too long?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141263506/652979611/-1197072038?refcode=2026-10-12-aare&recurring=&amount=14&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=09c5224d-69c6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOWM1MjI0ZC02OWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DWpj77A9zr8UuB-eLp73NYmxyYcAVq74APZCREB9jw8=) I'm working to show up in communities that rarely hear from either party, talk about what really keeps families up at night, and win the House and Senate majorities we need to lower costs and protect healthcare. **I believe the next decade is going to be the most dynamic in Asian American politics this country has ever seen. I want Democrats to be ready for it, and I want to be part of leading the way.** But the fight starts now, and it starts with this election. A new poll from APIA Vote found that 42% of Asian and Pacific Islander voters were never contacted by a single Democratic organization in the last year. That is a failure, and it's one we can fix. = When I sat down with families, small business owners and community leaders in Houston, nobody asked me about a special agenda. They asked about what everyone asks about: the cost of housing, the cost of healthcare, and how to keep a small business afloat when everything keeps getting more expensive. We're not a special interest group. We want a seat at the table for the really big things, like the economy, healthcare and affordability. Democrats should be fighting for every one of those votes. That's why I'm taking this on the road. Houston was just the start. I'm headed to North Carolina, New Hampshire and more states across the Senate map, because in race after race, Asian American voters can be the difference between a win and a loss. = I'm working to show up in communities that rarely hear from either party, talk about what really keeps families up at night, and win the House and Senate majorities we need to lower costs and protect healthcare. I believe the next decade is going to be the most dynamic in Asian American politics this country has ever seen. I want Democrats to be ready for it, and I want to be part of leading the way. | | | **Ever since I was a student, I knew I wanted to fight for justice and make a difference.** I’m the daughter of two special education teachers. I was raised in a working class family that instilled in me the values of hard work, opportunity, and serving others.

_So I always knew I wanted to fight for justice and make a difference._
It’s why I started my career investigating threats to democracy and civil rights.
Then I served as a law clerk to a federal civil rights judge in Detroit, protecting and defending people’s civil rights and freedoms.
Then, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to make sure all students could afford their education by freezing tuition and expanding scholarships.
It’s why, as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter access.
**But I know our work is far from finished. So now, I’m running for Governor to make sure Michigan is a place where everyone – from our kids to our seniors – can stay and thrive.**

clean_body: I know this might be the first time you’re hearing from me — so I wanted to take a step back and tell you a little bit more about me and why I’m running to be the next Governor of Michigan. | | | | = | | | Peter,I know this might be the first time you’re hearing from me — so I wanted to take a step back and tell you a little bit more about me and why I’m running to be the next Governor of Michigan. = | | | | | | = | | | Ever since I was a student, I knew I wanted to fight for justice and make a difference. I’m the daughter of two special education teachers. I was raised in a working class family that instilled in me the values of hard work, opportunity, and serving others. So I always knew I wanted to fight for justice and make a difference. It’s why I started my career investigating threats to democracy and civil rights. Then I served as a law clerk to a federal civil rights judge in Detroit, protecting and defending people’s civil rights and freedoms. Then, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to make sure all students could afford their education by freezing tuition and expanding scholarships. It’s why, as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter access. But I know our work is far from finished. So now, I’m running for Governor to make sure Michigan is a place where everyone – from our kids to our seniors – can stay and thrive. But Michigan is one of the most competitive states in the country, and the latest polls show this race is going to be extremely close. Winning here won’t be easy... or cheap. I’m committed to building a campaign built by the people, for the people. While my Republican counterpart has already accepted $6 million from the DeVos family funneled into a shady super PAC, our campaign is building real momentum, and we can’t let it stall. With early voting starting _tomorrow_ , I wanted to share an update on my pivotal U.S. Senate race in Georgia and ask for your support.
A branch of the president's Super PAC, MAGA Inc., is spending big in Georgia, along with Senate Republicans' top Super PAC. Republicans have committed to spending over _**$70 million**_ to replace me with scandal-ridden bigot Mike Collins.
Now, a new poll from Quantus Insights shows me _statistically tied_ with my MAGA fanatic opponent.
This race is tightening, and with Georgians starting to vote tomorrow the timing is _not great_.
We need to respond and fight back immediately. If you're ready to help me, chip in to my reelection campaign using this link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-fr-substack-2026](https://substack.com/redirect/acfb6fb6-5a90-4e1d-8e12-ee5db8664b06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I'm sure you've heard all the different ways we can win a Senate majority.
The truth is that they all share one thing in common: **We have to successfully defend this Senate seat in Georgia. It remains the pivotal battleground state in the country.**
We cannot take this race for granted. We have to continue and grow our voter outreach efforts in order to win in November. And that work requires a massive amount of resources.
My campaign doesn't accept contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. That means I rely on people like you, who are furious about what's being done to our country and want to make a difference by chipping in to send MAGA a powerful message and have my back.
**[So I 'm personally asking: Can you donate to my reelection campaign today? This election is just about upon us, and it's up to citizens to turn things around and right the ship.](https://substack.com/redirect/acfb6fb6-5a90-4e1d-8e12-ee5db8664b06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Jon

The silence is deafening.

Right now America is facing what may be its [biggest national emergency ever](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=b7f1ebbfdff6497ba82f712518ef14ec&_e=xuJqkzeKi-FsnB9k-3aMZS8vCNXk7kb3kT8u_YFaBxNQ2fWFYUYgVcFjSDT3mVN4a7Sh7gqURR910WySJWUJ532-TPvQD7ZmeTFBrHDN5AFfQNMKkX5F0QDRC-XZkoeKfeNFB_LJ928TUyu_0r2rMyLgbJmlgN-O5Dc_Ge3eLkiL45UXMBvoPa6LrybIuqgfW3X0RnI3sEd6JHz99tE2t2J07eEQaT08NqBts7RwfP599oMfZgjZx83Rw1uIbZWX_ypHEY7GTJG1Lp2BnhclC1RXtu6zMa_G_j25XTZaFx0EVcrEA2j9zCAspwzpgJBIdVdcGBxhRVQxSMk15hi6Gsje05PZu3dKI_8DTwu8NAHC1DQEOk9hpFIEw5OETD3oRdbA_7l5bV2p-Y52jgR3UFGpJuQrt9tswr3IW4dOvlYpmvZO2R-VzsST1KM27u8GAwL4A9-pl6jFHN3TNT2ABL--PDI9veSGEYcDaupI2V9GLyEkLnrTXoVYDJf_N_74DiDOYNQ0CyXnktFM-8AaVxQjNb5LutA5A2a06bDnteo%3D).

And yet... turn on CNN or Fox News... what do you see?

Gaza. Ukraine. Jeffrey Epstein.

All distractions from what’s really going on. Noise.

The silence is deafening.

What I’m about to tell you might shock you.

But for some damn reason I can’t figure out... you won’t hear it from anybody else.

So let me tell it to you straight:

**Washington is preparing for war.**

They’re invoking emergency powers... issuing executive orders... and funneling trillions into a rapid economic mobilization.

Why?

Because a force Elon Musk has called _“the most likely cause of World War 3”_ is now demanding a full-scale economic response.

It’s the reason Trump has been raising trillions of dollars from the Middle East...

The reason he forced Zelensky to hand over rights to half of Ukraine’s enormous mineral deposits...

It’s the reason Apple is spending $500 billion to bring their factories back to U.S. soil...

It’s even behind the President’s strange obsession with Greenland.

In fact, when referring to the event as a "gangbang" she [texted](https://substack.com/redirect/59e8f6f6-308c-4a79-9362-57a502d12da3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to one of the participants, "i don't think we should feel any shame for the part. our body our choice."

But this young lady, in spite of being brainwashed with the feminist view of sexual equality, soon learned that women who behave promiscuously, are not treated by society the same as men who do the same. Promiscuous men are called "studs" and "swordsmen." I will not repeat what promiscuous women are called.

She was soon ostracized by the other women in her sorority and disinvited to a Halloween Party sponsored by the Chi Phi fraternity where the incident occurred.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5536d041-e57a-4fc8-8f3f-e43dd9f52d81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

The now closed Chi Phi fraternity at Cornell University

The Cornell administration became aware of the incident and closed the Chi Phi fraternity while either suspending or expelling the seven men involved. The Cornell University Police Department asked the local District Attorney (DA) to investigate. But the DA [refused to press charges](https://substack.com/redirect/46613d07-35b3-454b-bbb0-4f6e2ef15936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the men because:

"Jane Doe's [pseudonym for the woman's real name] sworn statement in November of 2024 did not allege that she was drugged against her will or gang raped. On the contrary, Jane Doe's statement described her participation in drug use and sexual conduct as voluntary, conscious, and consensual."

But the psychological wounds in this abused woman festered, and in 2026, she filed a civil suit against Cornell University, the national Chi Phi organization, her own sorority, and the local bar that served her alcohol even though she was underaged. And now politicians such as New York Attorney General Letitia James have joined the fray.

But when the dust settles, the real villains should be our cultural leaders who have turned sexual activity into a recreational sport and successfully silenced religious leaders who criticized this trend as unenlightened prudes.

Would men at an Ivy League institution engaged in such degenerate behavior in the 1950s? Would they have lined up to copulate with a drunk and drugged woman? Probably not.

So why is this happening now?

While Cornell University is feigning outrage at this behavior, its own health department [circulated a pamphlet ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec1b03d8-23c2-426f-80fb-30937fd3f7e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to its students that encourages promiscuous behavior by promoting discussions of fetishes and group sex. In fact, one of the options listed in the pamphlet under "Relationship Models and Choices" are:

___ Sex of some kind(s) with two partners at a time
___ Sex of some kind(s) with three partners at a time
___ Sex of some kind(s) with more than three partners at a time

It will be interesting to see how Cornell University defends itself in this lawsuit.

But the main message of this event is that men are genetically programmed by evolution to be promiscuous. The goal of every species is to reproduce. And since men can impregnate more than one woman at a time, powerful men have had multiple wives, mistresses and harems so that they could do so. Women, on the other hand, can only carry the child of one man at a time. Biology 101.

This is why Christianity became so popular with women when promulgated two thousand years ago. Monogamous men are more reliable providers and do not infect their spouses with STDs (Sexually Transmitted Diseases).

Furthermore, some men will plop down $200 on their lunch break to copulate with a woman they has never seen before and not even share a common language, as long as the woman meets certain physical standards. Women, rarely if ever do this.

Why?

Because evolution has wired men and women's brains differently.

Yet, crazy feminists have convinced many young women that being promiscuous is natural and will make them feel fulfilled. It is not coincidence that this woman's statement "our body our choice" is the mantra of the pro-abortionists.

So, it is not surprising that even Ivy League men behave like dirtballs.

But as these men are about to find out, our legal system is about to enforce the same values that religion used to enforce. And perhaps this will be warning to other men not to behave like dirtballs.

Texas has 20 separate media markets, and national donors routinely pass the state over because reaching all of them is so expensive. And one in five Texas voters still don't know who I am. clean_body: The New York Times last polled our race 3 months ago and found us down 7. This poll has swung 10 points since then. | = Peter, look at this: = In June, The New York Times /Siena poll had me trailing Greg Abbott by 7 points, 51% to 44%. Now, that same poll has me ahead, 49% to 46%. That's a 10-point swing in three months, from one of the most respected pollsters in the country. It's not a fluke, either. This is the third poll showing us ahead of Abbott, and it's the most recent one, taken after weeks of Abbott's attack ads flooding Texas airwaves. = The New York Times also ran a major story on the state of play in Texas. Read this: = Ten-to-one. Abbott has thrown everything he has at this race, and he still can't put it away. Wendy Davis put it this way in the same article: "People have vastly underestimated Gina. Dollar for dollar, she's running the best statewide campaign we've ever seen." That's what grassroots supporters like you have built $5 and $10 at a time. We haven't come close to matching Abbott's money, but every dollar has gone further than anyone thought it could. = The Times was also honest about what still stands in our way. Texas has 20 separate media markets, and national donors routinely pass the state over because reaching all of them is so expensive. And one in five Texas voters still don't know who I am. Here's what the last three months have taught us: the more Texans get to know me, the more this race moves. Every one of those voters is someone we can reach, but only if we have the resources to do it. Abbott has raised more than $106 million in this race, and he's going to keep spending it in the final month to drag this race back his way. We are 22 days from Election Day. The polls tell us this race can be won. What happens next depends on whether we have the financial resources to communicate our message to the voters who need to hear it. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = For 32 years, Texans have been told a Democrat can't win statewide. A 10-point swing after more than $70 million in spending against us says otherwise. Let's go take Texas back. Urgent grassroots memo for your immediate attention:
#############################################

| | | | Peter, You've got both Ted and Ken writing to you today. It takes an **unprecedented threat** for the two of us to pull over on the campaign trail, sit down, and write you a joint message. _But _that threat_ is here - and it's more real than you could ever imagine_. We're on the campaign trail fighting together to save Texas from turning blue for the first time in nearly 40 YEARS. If Democrats finally win here, they'll believe they have an absolute mandate to impose the most left-wing agenda in American history. _Now, here 's the part that truly has us worried._ The orders sent from the National Democrats are crystal clear: **_pour every last dime into flipping Texas, because it 's the KEY to ending the President's Majority._****_ _**_Right now, we 're nearing the FINAL CLOSE OF BOOKS FUNDRAISING DEADLINE set by the Federal Election Commission_. **Whatever we have in the bank by 10/14 at 11:59 P.M. is the exact number we have to report for the FINAL push.** This FINAL FEC deadline is our _ONE_ and _ONLY CHANCE_ to even the score or let the Democrats capture Texas' Senate seat after 40 years. **_Because of the stakes of this deadline, we 're jointly reaching out to you - My family, while I was growing up in China
---
Dear Patriot,
I never got to use a toilet seat. Instead, we had to share a hole in the ground with 8 other families.
I was raised on food rationing coupons in the Sichuan province of China during Mao's Cultural Revolution. I was only a child, yet I worshiped him like a God.

I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.

Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District **RED** in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight.
Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent announced she raised over $1.6 MILLION in the last quarter alone.
_They will stop at absolutely nothing to win._

Thank you all so very, very much!
\- Jen Kiggans

|

_Peter, this is Mazie. Below is a message from Peggy Flanagan, who is running for Senate in Minnesota. Please read her message below, and I hope you will join me in standing with Peggy._
* * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141266089/652988700/-1377867294?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20261012_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDU5N2I0OC03MWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TN47Bv5Z15aoFlQpjsNjcm0fm-shzv6L8eI7QJ-fxa0=) Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you. I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life. Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that. **_But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate._** It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. clean_body: | Peter, this is Mazie. Below is a message from Peggy Flanagan, who is running for Senate in Minnesota. Please read her message below, and I hope you will join me in standing with Peggy. = Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you. I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life. Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that. But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate. It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. I know we've been reaching out a lot, but by 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday, we really need to hit our $2 million final FEC goal before the election. Right now, we're falling short, but if another 10,000 grassroots donors contribute before midnight, we can close the gap.
Missing this goal is simply not an option. Let me explain:
Republicans are spending big on winning this Senate seat -- more than $23 million so far. Missing our goal means we can't keep our own ads on the air. It means that we let Sen. Marshall and his corporate PAC donors have the last word.
In the few months since this campaign began, I've learned this: **In a tight race like ours,**_**every dollar counts**_**.**
We set monthly fundraising goals like this one to folks like you with full faith that this incredible group of supporters will step up. **[Please, I am counting on you to pitch in any amount toward our goal of $2 million before 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd9264e3-ce0f-4cae-8c5a-8e484f397668?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Thank you in advance for supporting our movement to fight the chaos and corruption in Washington and restore common sense and decency to our politics.
With gratitude,
Adam

Steve Robinson joined Jack Posobiec on Human Events Daily to talk Maine's Senate race and Medicaid fraud. Robinson called Senator Susan Collins favored against Troy Jackson but said it will be the closest race she has had. He walked through Jackson's record as Senate president, including his switch on three gun control bills after his son's lobbying firm, Resurgam Group, got a $50,000 contract with the Maine Gun Safety Coalition. On the Ilhan Omar raid, Robinson said Maine and Minnesota fraud is "really just one scandal," and described being on site when Homeland Security searched the Lewiston office of the Gateway Community Services CEO.

name: Dave Beckwith for Congress
subject: Day 116 of 136. Why have we been voting ALL year?
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
In short, because of the Democrats in Virginia.
| | | |
---
| | Hi Friend,
Today is day _116 of 136 days of voting_ in Virginia this year. That is 50 percent more than a normal year, and I get why so many of us are tired of it.
Here is why it happened. In April, Democrats pushed a redistricting referendum to redraw Virginia’s congressional map. The Democrats in Richmond spent upwards of $100 million campaigning for the illegal map (imagine what else they could've done with that money) and we had to have a full 45 day voting period to vote on the matter.
Despite the wasteful effort, the Virginia Supreme Court later struck it down as unconstitutional.
My opponent, Suhas Subramanyam, campaigned on the priority to “combat political gerrymandering so that voters choose who represents them, not the other way around” in 2024. But when it came time to practice what he preached, he went back on his word and **actively campaigned for a map that would have removed all of Fauquier and Rappahannock counties and a large part of Prince William County from VA-10,** in exchange for a district more favorable to Democrats.
That was _less than two years_ after he asked these same voters to trust him with their vote.
**__Suhas showed us a perfect example of what putting party over district looks like_._**
I will always put the families of this district first, and I need your help to make sure every voter in VA-10 knows the difference.
**Our pre-election FEC report closes on Wednesday, October 14.** That report is the snapshot voters, donors, and the press use to judge whether this race is competitive. Every dollar you give before then counts toward it.
---
[CHIP IN TO HELP SPREAD THIS MESSAGE RIGHT NOW](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
| | | God bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_

_PS - The report closes in two days, and I do not want to leave anything on the table. Chip in now to help us show that VA-10 is ready for a Congressman who_ actually _represents his people.___
---

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: DHS raided my house this morning.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261012-movement-split.gqam5J&refcode=em20261012-2817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20 ]Headline from The New York Times: Homeland Security Agents Search Home
of Rep. Ilhan Omar.

Peter, Donald
Trump’s fascism and abuse of power has now come to my literal front door.

This morning, DHS agents raided and searched my home in the DC area as the
latest step in their ludicrous, partisan investigation into my immigration
status.

I have been in Trump’s crosshairs for years, but now he is escalating in a
desperate attempt to drag me and the entire progressive movement down
ahead of the midterms.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261012-movement-split.gqam5J&refcode=em20261012-2817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20 ]This is a critical moment for our democracy, and we must be decisive.
Please, stand by me and our movement today by rushing a contribution,
split between me and the Squad Victory Fund, to help me fight back in the
face of Trump’s abuse of power >>

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261012-movement-split.gqam5J&refcode=em20261012-2817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20 ]RUSH A DONATION

It’s no accident that this raid comes three weeks before an election where
I’m on the ballot.

This is part of the fascist playbook to rile up Trump’s die-hard
supporters and give them a big distraction in advance of the midterms.
With this obviously political investigation, Trump is telling his voters:
"Ignore the price of gas, ignore the war in Iran, ignore that you’re
losing your healthcare — we want you to get angry about this instead.”

Throughout his presidency, Trump has weaponized the DOJ to target his
political opponents, manufacturing charges that have been roundly
dismissed by court after court. And I’m not even the first member of
Congress to be targeted. The point is to waste everyone’s time and
resources, and generate negative headlines for his opponents.

I will repeat what I have long said: This is a ludicrous investigation,
and Trump’s escalation is only further proof that he is willing to use the
power of the federal government to try to intimidate and silence anyone
who stands up to him. It’s up to us to make sure it doesn’t work.

In just a few weeks we can strike a major blow at Trump’s fascist agenda
and end this era of authoritarianism by taking Congress back from MAGA.
Today, as I stand in the breach of Trump’s endless attacks and immense
power to do harm, I’m asking for your support:

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261012-movement-split.gqam5J&refcode=em20261012-2817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20 ]Please, stand with me today by splitting a generous donation between me
and the Squad Victory Fund. Your donation will help me not only fight back
against this incredible abuse of power, but continue to organize our
movement for democracy, peace, and affordability ahead of what is shaping
up to be one of the most important elections of our lives.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20261012-movement-split.gqam5J&refcode=em20261012-2817&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20 ]Contribute ››

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2817%2E342411%2EafgA20

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

name: Sherrod Brown
subject: On my mind
body:
Thank you for having my back, again and again.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261012-2.KfmlE7&refcode=em-20261012-2&t=1&akid=2100%2E1086043%2EG4Dx-S)
Peter,
We're just under one month out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: **I don’t want to let you down.**
_You_ are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When Peter Thiel dropped $3.6 million against me in a single week, you helped keep our own ads live.
* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.
* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $30 million behind new attack ads spreading lies about me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, Peter.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to _pour_ in. **In fact, Republican megadonors are spending more here than in Georgia, Alaska, and North Carolina combined. Let that sink in.**
I’m not sharing this to scare you -- the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win -- but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive _only_ because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
**[Today, I’m asking you to split $5 between my campaign and Wes Moore. I’m counting on you. Will you give what you can to help us flip Ohio and take back the Senate?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261012-2.KfmlE7&refcode=em-20261012-2&t=2&akid=2100%2E1086043%2EG4Dx-S)**

Thank you for keeping us in this fight,
Sherrod Brown

clean_body: The House majority will come down to districts like ours. | | Peter, I was first elected to Congress in 2018, so I know what it takes to build a “Blue Wave.” Together, we have won some of the closest and most competitive elections in the country over the last several cycles. 2026 will be another historic election, but I think it’s going to be a lot closer and more competitive than many people think. # [Snapchat's options traders are betting Meta's agent halo lifts a broken stock](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Snapchat is up almost 20% this month after spending more than a year under $10, down from the $80-plus high in 2021 to the $3.81 April low. Monday's options tape showed the first real volume in months: nearly 140,000 contracts, more than four times the recent average, with about 64,000 calls bought against under 7,000 puts and $5 million of the $5.5 million in premium tied to calls.
* **Winners?** Call buyers who bought the Dec 18 $8 strike 26,000 times at roughly 37 cents; they need a 30% move to get paid and would mark the highest print since February if they get it.
* **Losers?** Anyone still short the name that treated the Specs AR push and Blue Duck's $5 billion stake letter as noise instead of a catalyst.
* **Next?** Watch whether the Meta Muse agent headlines keep volume elevated; the $8 strike is the tell, and a clean break toward $10 would force the next round of covering.

This is still a damaged asset trading on someone else's AI story. The Specs glasses and the activist letter give it a narrative, but the options market is pricing a 30% bounce on Meta spillover, not on Snap's own numbers. That works until it doesn't. If the agent hype cools, the same tape that just printed 140,000 contracts will reverse just as fast.

# [The AI bull market turns four with yields still the open question](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The S&P 500 is up nearly 120% from its Oct 12, 2022 closing low and just cleared 7,800 for the first time last week. Nvidia sits above $5 trillion and remains the poster child of the entire run. Oppenheimer's Ari Wald notes this is the sixth-longest bull of the 24 since 1932; the median remaining life to a peak is 13 months, which points at 2027 as the potential final leg, while the median fifth-year return across history has been 21%.
* **Winners?** Anyone who stayed long the AI complex through the wall of worry--higher inflation, surging yields, and a more hawkish Fed--and still owns the names that carried the index.
* **Losers?** Small-cap and breadth believers who kept waiting for the Russell 2000 to confirm; relative weakness in the 200-day is a warning, not an invitation, until conditions actually improve.
* **Next?** The path of the 10-year and whether earnings can keep clearing elevated expectations; Deutsche Bank already flags the tech rotation as overdone on a risk-reward basis.

We called the **[Bessent boom](https://substack.com/redirect/ea088455-7f6c-45c1-9269-2a35483c6ac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** real while the press slept on the tape. The four-year mark with the index near records and yields still elevated is exactly that setup. Year five is not free. The median path says there is still room, but the breadth and the bond market are the two variables that have to cooperate. If they don't, the median 13 months to peak gets compressed in a hurry.

# [Meta ships Muse Wonder and keeps the agent lead](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meta released Muse Wonder and the larger Muse Wonder Full models Monday, positioning them for personal and professional agent tasks that require resilience when a step fails. Wonder is available in the Muse app on $20 or $100 monthly plans and via the Meta Model API at prices the company says sit meaningfully below OpenAI and Anthropic. Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers at the higher $50 or $200 tier. The models are built to keep working past roadblocks instead of stalling, with the strongest cyber safeguards Meta has offered to date.
* **Winners?** Meta shareholders who already own the agent that hit #1 on the App Store and just got a stronger model underneath it; the subscription tiers give a direct revenue path outside ads.
* **Losers?** Anyone still arguing Meta is permanently behind on agents after the Muse launch; this is the second major model drop from the Superintelligence Labs setup in a short window.
* **Next?** Watch retention and conversion numbers on the paid Muse tiers; if Wonder lifts usage the way the company claims, the agent becomes a measurable revenue line instead of just a headline.

I said **[Meta bulls were back](https://substack.com/redirect/f2cf7785-33f0-457f-9ecc-c55ec1caf64e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and the $700 level was the tell. The stock cleared it, Muse hit the top of the App Store, and now the company is shipping the model upgrade that keeps the agent ahead of the pack. The gap versus the competition is not closed, but Meta is no longer the one playing catch-up on the consumer agent side. That is the tape that matters.

# [LVMH's earnings miss shows China is still the problem](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
LVMH posted third-quarter organic sales of €18.5 billion ($20.7 billion), up 1% and short of the 1.3% consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, nearly half of group revenue, fell 5% organically versus an expected 1.8% decline. Asia, dominated by China, dropped 5% while the U.S. rose 5%. The company cited a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer sentiment early in the quarter, a tax crackdown on wealthy individuals, and backlash around a Louis Vuitton logo dispute with a tea chain. Europe's luxury groups have lost roughly €330 billion in market value this year; LVMH alone is down about 40%.
* **Winners?** Anyone who stayed underweight the China-exposed luxury complex; jewelry and watches held up, but the core fashion engine did not.
* **Losers?** Investors who treated the second-quarter stabilization as the turn; the third quarter reversed it and the stock was down nearly 3% on the print.
* **Next?** Q4 will be watched for any sequential improvement in China traffic; without it, the sector stays a relative underperformer regardless of what happens in the U.S.

This is the same China consumption story that has been grinding on the sector all year. A 5% miss in the most important division is not a rounding error. The U.S. held up, but Asia is still the swing factor and it swung the wrong way. Until Chinese sentiment stabilizes, the valuation reset in LVMH and the rest of the group has further to run.

# [Sandisk is the cleanest memory winner of the AI bull market](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Sandisk has gained more than 3,000% since its February 2025 spin from Western Digital at $52, making it the best-performing S&P 500 stock over the life of the bull market--ahead of Palantir, Vertiv, Nvidia, and Micron. Shares traded around $1,479 on Monday with a market cap above $200 billion. At its August investor day management guided to mid-to-high teens annual revenue growth from 2028 through 2030 and non-GAAP gross margins near 80%. The stock was down on Monday after a Chinese memory announcement, but the longer-term setup remains the AI infrastructure demand for NAND.
* **Winners?** Anyone who owned the spin-off from the start; the combination of AI data-center demand and disciplined industry supply has turned a commodity business into a high-margin growth story.
* **Losers?** Shorts who treated memory as a pure cyclical and missed the structural shift that has already produced Micron's 87% gross margins and Sandisk's own guidance.
* **Next?** Watch whether the mid-teens growth and 80% margin targets hold as more capacity comes online; the Chinese news is noise until it actually moves the supply-demand balance.

I called **[Micron the next Nvidia](https://substack.com/redirect/629e67e3-16bc-4fbd-8b3d-11189e6589dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and the October print delivered the 87% margins. Sandisk is the pure NAND expression of the same shortage. The valuation is no longer cheap on trailing numbers, but the forward guidance and the AI demand trajectory are what the market is paying for. This is still a picks-and-shovels name in a cycle that has not ended.

# [A handful of tech names are hiding an ugly S&P 500](https://substack.com/redirect/60c1cb10-0060-4ff8-838e-4e9a00d22ca1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Eighty-four percent of S&P 500 stocks are at least 10% below their all-time highs, 59% are down 20% or more, 41% are down more than 30%, and 17% are off by more than 50%. Real estate has 97% of its stocks at least 10% off the highs, materials 96%, utilities 94%, and consumer discretionary 92%. Technology itself still shows 72% of names below that threshold. Nvidia, Micron, and a few other AI-related names are carrying the index while the median stock has gone nowhere meaningful in 2026. The bull market that turns four on Monday is the 11th since the 1950s.
* **Winners?** Holders of the concentrated AI complex that has produced the entire advance; without them the index would look nothing like a bull market.
* **Losers?** Broad-market and equal-weight investors who have been waiting for participation that has not arrived; the breadth deterioration is the clearest warning on the tape.
* **Next?** Either the AI names keep carrying the load through the next earnings cycle, or the lack of breadth forces a more violent rotation once the concentration premium gets tested.

This is the same concentration story we have been tracking since the Bessent boom call and the October 5 note on AI versus the rest of the market. The index is near records. The average stock is not. That gap has widened, not narrowed, as the bull market hit its fourth birthday. Until the advance broadens or the leaders crack, the tape remains a two-tier market and the risk is that the second tier stays stuck while the first tier gets priced for perfection.

clean_body: but how long is it going to last? | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? but how long is it going to last? | | | Oct 12 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Snapchat is up almost 20% this month after spending more than a year under $10, down from the $80-plus high in 2021 to the $3.81 April low. Monday's options tape showed the first real volume in months: nearly 140,000 contracts, more than four times the recent average, with about 64,000 calls bought against under 7,000 puts and $5 million of the $5.5 million in premium tied to calls. Winners? Call buyers who bought the Dec 18 $8 strike 26,000 times at roughly 37 cents; they need a 30% move to get paid and would mark the highest print since February if they get it. Losers? Anyone still short the name that treated the Specs AR push and Blue Duck's $5 billion stake letter as noise instead of a catalyst. Next? Watch whether the Meta Muse agent headlines keep volume elevated; the $8 strike is the tell, and a clean break toward $10 would force the next round of covering. This is still a damaged asset trading on someone else's AI story. The Specs glasses and the activist letter give it a narrative, but the options market is pricing a 30% bounce on Meta spillover, not on Snap's own numbers. That works until it doesn't. If the agent hype cools, the same tape that just printed 140,000 contracts will reverse just as fast. | | ---|---|--- If you're a business owner you know that expenses pop up at any time, whether or not you have the cash sitting in the bank Maybe your restaurant is ready for a second location. Or your construction company needs to finance new equipment. Or you need some extra cash to make payroll or renovate your office. Sometimes you need access to capitalnow and you don't have time for all the hoops a bank will put you through. If your business generates at least $25,000 in monthly revenue, you can apply for business funding from Delta Capital in a few clicks, get an approval in minutes and get funds wired within the hour with no impact on your personal credit. Whether you're buying equipment, stocking up on inventory, expanding your business, or taking on your next big opportunity, Delta Capital can approve up to $500,000 in business funding in under 5 minutes. And wire the funds within the hour. So if your business is generating $25,000 or more a month, The S&P 500 is up nearly 120% from its Oct 12, 2022 closing low and just cleared 7,800 for the first time last week. Nvidia sits above $5 trillion and remains the poster child of the entire run. Oppenheimer's Ari Wald notes this is the sixth-longest bull of the 24 since 1932; the median remaining life to a peak is 13 months, which points at 2027 as the potential final leg, while the median fifth-year return across history has been 21%. Winners? Anyone who stayed long the AI complex through the wall of worry--higher inflation, surging yields, and a more hawkish Fed--and still owns the names that carried the index. Losers? Small-cap and breadth believers who kept waiting for the Russell 2000 to confirm; relative weakness in the 200-day is a warning, not an invitation, until conditions actually improve. Next? The path of the 10-year and whether earnings can keep clearing elevated expectations; Deutsche Bank already flags the tech rotation as overdone on a risk-reward basis. We called the real while the press slept on the tape. The four-year mark with the index near records and yields still elevated is exactly that setup. Year five is not free. The median path says there is still room, but the breadth and the bond market are the two variables that have to cooperate. If they don't, the median 13 months to peak gets compressed in a hurry. The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you! Meta released Muse Wonder and the larger Muse Wonder Full models Monday, positioning them for personal and professional agent tasks that require resilience when a step fails. Wonder is available in the Muse app on $20 or $100 monthly plans and via the Meta Model API at prices the company says sit meaningfully below OpenAI and Anthropic. Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers at the higher $50 or $200 tier. The models are built to keep working past roadblocks instead of stalling, with the strongest cyber safeguards Meta has offered to date. Winners? Meta shareholders who already own the agent that hit #1 on the App Store and just got a stronger model underneath it; the subscription tiers give a direct revenue path outside ads. Losers? Anyone still arguing Meta is permanently behind on agents after the Muse launch; this is the second major model drop from the Superintelligence Labs setup in a short window. Next? Watch retention and conversion numbers on the paid Muse tiers; if Wonder lifts usage the way the company claims, the agent becomes a measurable revenue line instead of just a headline. I said and the $700 level was the tell. The stock cleared it, Muse hit the top of the App Store, and now the company is shipping the model upgrade that keeps the agent ahead of the pack. The gap versus the competition is not closed, but Meta is no longer the one playing catch-up on the consumer agent side. That is the tape that matters. LVMH posted third-quarter organic sales of €18.5 billion ($20.7 billion), up 1% and short of the 1.3% consensus. The fashion and leather goods division, nearly half of group revenue, fell 5% organically versus an expected 1.8% decline. Asia, dominated by China, dropped 5% while the U.S. rose 5%. The company cited a sharp deterioration in Chinese consumer sentiment early in the quarter, a tax crackdown on wealthy individuals, and backlash around a Louis Vuitton logo dispute with a tea chain. Europe's luxury groups have lost roughly €330 billion in market value this year; LVMH alone is down about 40%. Winners? Anyone who stayed underweight the China-exposed luxury complex; jewelry and watches held up, but the core fashion engine did not. Losers? Investors who treated the second-quarter stabilization as the turn; the third quarter reversed it and the stock was down nearly 3% on the print. Next? Q4 will be watched for any sequential improvement in China traffic; without it, the sector stays a relative underperformer regardless of what happens in the U.S. This is the same China consumption story that has been grinding on the sector all year. A 5% miss in the most important division is not a rounding error. The U.S. held up, but Asia is still the swing factor and it swung the wrong way. Until Chinese sentiment stabilizes, the valuation reset in LVMH and the rest of the group has further to run. Sandisk has gained more than 3,000% since its February 2025 spin from Western Digital at $52, making it the best-performing S&P 500 stock over the life of the bull market--ahead of Palantir, Vertiv, Nvidia, and Micron. Shares traded around $1,479 on Monday with a market cap above $200 billion. At its August investor day management guided to mid-to-high teens annual revenue growth from 2028 through 2030 and non-GAAP gross margins near 80%. The stock was down on Monday after a Chinese memory announcement, but the longer-term setup remains the AI infrastructure demand for NAND. Winners? Anyone who owned the spin-off from the start; the combination of AI data-center demand and disciplined industry supply has turned a commodity business into a high-margin growth story. Losers? Shorts who treated memory as a pure cyclical and missed the structural shift that has already produced Micron's 87% gross margins and Sandisk's own guidance. Next? Watch whether the mid-teens growth and 80% margin targets hold as more capacity comes online; the Chinese news is noise until it actually moves the supply-demand balance. I called and the October print delivered the 87% margins. Sandisk is the pure NAND expression of the same shortage. The valuation is no longer cheap on trailing numbers, but the forward guidance and the AI demand trajectory are what the market is paying for. This is still a picks-and-shovels name in a cycle that has not ended. Eighty-four percent of S&P 500 stocks are at least 10% below their all-time highs, 59% are down 20% or more, 41% are down more than 30%, and 17% are off by more than 50%. Real estate has 97% of its stocks at least 10% off the highs, materials 96%, utilities 94%, and consumer discretionary 92%. Technology itself still shows 72% of names below that threshold. Nvidia, Micron, and a few other AI-related names are carrying the index while the median stock has gone nowhere meaningful in 2026. The bull market that turns four on Monday is the 11th since the 1950s. Winners? Holders of the concentrated AI complex that has produced the entire advance; without them the index would look nothing like a bull market. Losers? Broad-market and equal-weight investors who have been waiting for participation that has not arrived; the breadth deterioration is the clearest warning on the tape. Next? Either the AI names keep carrying the load through the next earnings cycle, or the lack of breadth forces a more violent rotation once the concentration premium gets tested. This is the same concentration story we have been tracking since the Bessent boom call and the October 5 note on AI versus the rest of the market. The index is near records. The average stock is not. That gap has widened, not narrowed, as the bull market hit its fourth birthday. Until the advance broadens or the leaders crack, the tape remains a two-tier market and the risk is that the second tier stays stuck while the first tier gets priced for perfection. Snap is trading Meta's agent story. The bull market is four years old and still narrow. Meta just shipped the next agent model. Luxury took another China hit. Sandisk is the memory standout. clean_body: | | Pete Hegseth is making it harder for troops to file complaints and dismissing scrutiny of powerful people as "weaponized." | I commanded troops in combat. I know good leaders protect the person brave enough to report wrongdoing; they do not rig the process to protect themselves. In Congress, I will defend independent watchdogs and the service members who rely on them. Hegseth calls his overhaul "no more walking on eggshells." His changes restrict anonymous complaints, create new barriers before investigations begin, and give commanders more authority over which allegations move forward. This is Pete Hegseth making himself and his allies harder to question. A young service member reporting harassment, abuse, or misconduct should not have to calculate whether telling the truth will end a career. Hegseth is turning that fear into policy. Strong commanders welcome facts --even inconvenient ones. Weak leaders attack the watchdog. ~~ ~~ Thank you, Ret. Brigadier General Shawn Harris | | ~~ "Facebook" ~ "X" \[BLUESKY\] "Bluesky" PAID FOR BY SHAWN FOR GEORGIA

Team, This is it. **_Early voting for the November 3 Election starts THIS WEEK across all 95 counties in Tennessee._ Early voting will run from October 14 through October 29.** As voters head to the polls, we’re not leaving anything to chance. Republicans have spent years trying to make voting harder, gerrymandering our maps, and creating confusion at the ballot box. But Tennessee Democrats aren't going down without giving them the fight of their lifetime. _**🤫 Special Guest Teaser:**_ Before early voting doors open, we are hosting an urgent, statewide **TNDP Voter Protection Mobilization Call.** We are bringing in a **very special national civil rights champion & surprise guest speaker** who knows what it takes to defend the ballot in the South and stand up to voter intimidation! _(We’ll be officially revealing our surprise guest to everyone soon, but if you want to be among the FIRST to know, sign up to be a TNDP Poll Watcher!)_ | [RSVP & SIGN UP AS A TNDP POLL WATCHER HERE »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141268784/652997365/437764565?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTA4MTliYi03Y2M2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HF0zLgeMf9fd0mmMOprA2pAjfA6yujxpzG7XgN2Vy1I=&emci=cfa46a15-73c6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=ca0819bb-7cc6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=6362892)

_** 📞 Our Statewide Voter Protection Hotline is LIVE: 833-DEM-VOTE**_
Whether a voter is turned away at the precinct, faces long lines, encounters confusion over new district lines, or witnesses improper intimidation, our **833-DEM-VOTE** assistance hotline is active statewide.
When a voter calls 833-DEM-VOTE, they get connected directly to trained election workers and a rapid-response team of volunteer attorneys ready to resolve issues in real time.
Together, we are making sure every eligible Tennessean can cast their ballot with confidence, safety, and dignity.

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]Abdul for US Senate

Planning to come volunteer in Michigan and looking for housing? [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1732?t=1004&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]We’ll
match you with a host!

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1732?t=1005&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ][IMG]

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1732?t=1006&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]GET HOUSINGHaven’t signed up to volunteer yet? Join our [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1678?t=1007&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]National
Organizing Call this Wednesday with Senator Bernie Sanders, Congresswoman
Rashida Tlaib, and Abdul to get started right away?

Peter,

We’re in the final stretch of the campaign and something remarkable is
happening.

People from all over the country are coming to Michigan to knock on doors.
And honestly, it’s already helping a lot. We’re up a few points in the
polls, but this race is far from being won. Mike Rogers and his Super PACs
are spending millions on attack ads. In these final weeks, every door we
knock matters. We need as many folks as possible to talk to Michiganders.
So today, I’m asking you to come to Michigan. We’ll find you a place to
stay!

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1732?t=1008&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]FIND HOUSING OPTIONS IN MICHIGAN

I just arrived in Detroit a couple of days ago. I used to help out
remotely as much as I could, but let me tell you: Coming here to volunteer
on the ground was the best decision I’ve made.

That’s why I’m so grateful to have found the most amazing people to host
me from now on through election day. Last night we were even watching the
debate together.

If you’ve been considering spending a couple of days here in Michigan,
consider this is your invitation. You don’t need any experience. The
campaign will train you. Come for a weekend or come for the whole final
stretch, whatever you can give.

Mike Rogers has the money, we have the many. Come be part of the movement
money can’t buy.[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1732?t=1009&akid=3529%2E251025%2EWRZopG ]SIGN UP FOR HOUSINGCan't wait to see you Michigan!

Sebastian
Volunteer for Abdul

subject: My response to Trump
body:
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1657&source=&t=1&akid=4514%2E124072%2ENjNeu1) | | | |

Donald Trump attacked me last night on Truth Social, again, calling me a “total fraud” and “radical.” He also gave his “complete and total endorsement” to his handpicked candidate Michael Whatley.
Then he woke up this morning, opened Truth Social and continued his dishonest diatribes. This is not the first time Trump has come after me, and it won’t be the last. But these recent attacks tell us one very important thing: Trump knows if Democrats flip this seat, then the MAGA agenda is in trouble, and he still thinks Whatley can win this race. And he’s right.
[**_If you’ve heard enough, consider donating $5, or whatever you can today before our last FEC deadline on Wednesday._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1657&amount=5&t=8&akid=4514%2E124072%2ENjNeu1)
Some national Republicans have quit concentrating on winning North Carolina. But Donald Trump is still here, still focused on North Carolina, still spreading lies about me and still propping up Whatley every chance he’s gotten.
**You don’t spend that kind of energy on a race you think you’ve lost.** Trump and his allies still think they can win this critical Senate seat, but we can’t let them.
Just last week, President Obama’s top strategist David Plouffe warned Democrats not to take North Carolina for granted, and that we can’t rest easy just yet.
This race is going to be a tough fight all the way until polls close, and we can’t let Trump's attacks turn the tide against us. But people are paying attention, and national news outlets have picked up on these attacks, adding fuel to the fire.
We’ve built a strong grassroots movement that has grounded us through this campaign, and the momentum we’ve built is real. But there is no time to get comfortable, especially after Trump attacked me just last night.
[**_We need to stay ahead of the lies and keep reaching voters in every corner of the state. But I can’t do that without your support. If you’re ready to fight back, please chip in $5 before our final FEC deadline on Wednesday._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1657&amount=5&t=9&akid=4514%2E124072%2ENjNeu1)
Every contribution, no matter the size, tells Trump and Whatley that North Carolinians – and our people-powered movement – are strong, and we’re not going anywhere.
Thank you for standing with me.

Roy
| |
