The raid was carried out by Homeland Security Investigations, part of the same Department of Homeland Security that answers to the president she has been fighting for years. This is the latest chapter in the most dangerous story of this presidency: federal law enforcement used as a weapon against the people Donald Trump doesn’t like. **Start with the Justice Department. Attorney General Todd Blanche spent years as Trump’s personal lawyer**. In his first press conference as acting attorney general, he said the president has a right and a duty to influence investigations, including those of his political enemies. Trump’s Justice Department has indicted James Comey and Letitia James. Those first cases collapsed, and Blanche’s department indicted Comey again. The Wall Street Journal counted more than four dozen people who have ended up in the president’s crosshairs. **Now look at DHS.** ICE agents tracked a New York man to his home, an airport, and a hotel to confront him over a critical email he sent to the head of ICE. DHS has reportedly issued hundreds of subpoenas to tech companies to unmask accounts that criticize ICE. And just days ago, DHS put out an official press release attacking a Democratic congressional candidate in Pennsylvania, Janelle Stelson, claiming a man ICE arrested worked for her campaign. Her campaign says he didn’t, and finance records show no payments to him. **_I’ve experienced a version of it as well: When I tried to conduct congressional oversight and inspect an ICE facility in Chicago, I was kicked out after a masked agent called the police on me._** A justice system that goes after the president’s critics isn’t a justice system. It’s a weapon, and weapons don’t stay in one hand. Today it’s a congresswoman, a former FBI director, a state attorney general, a man who wrote an email. Tomorrow it’s a Republican who crosses him, a judge who rules against him, a donor, a reporter, a neighbor. As a member of the Oversight Committee, it’s my job to ask these questions. **But Republicans control Congress and show no appetite for oversight**. In 22 days, we can change that. Hey team,
**The last day to register to vote before this election is October 19.**
That means we have just one week left to get everyone across our part of PA ready to vote. In a race like ours, we can't afford to leave anyone behind.
People here are fed up with rising costs, corruption in Washington, and a congressman who keeps getting richer while we get screwed.
**There are a ton of potential voters who want to make their voices heard on Election Day, but haven 't gotten around to registering yet.**
It's up to us to reach them. That takes serious resources, so I'm counting on your support to help us get it done.
**[Will you chip in any amount today so we can get as many people as possible registered before next week 's deadline?](https://substack.com/redirect/c15178c3-4cf8-49c0-98cf-e22e247e6995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Peter, I keep having to write to you about this administration hiding the cost of its illegal war, and every installment is worse than the last. First, Trump claimed _" no damage, no losses, no nothing"_ until leaked photos from our own bases proved otherwise, and the bill ran to billions a month. Then they pulled the ultimate coward's move and suppressed reporting of our war casualties. Now congressional researchers report 81 American military aircraft destroyed or damaged in this war, worth up to $3.3 billion, including an F-35 and an E-3 Sentry.

I served in the Air Force for 20 years and flew many combat missions, so let me translate those losses.
The F-35 is the crown jewel of American airpower, $80 million apiece, and this war has cost us one.
The E-3 watches the sky for everyone else, and crews depend on it to come home alive.
These losses put every American still flying out there in danger.
And every dollar of those losses comes out of your wallet.
Taxpayers are footing the bill for a war run by amateurs, and the Pentagon buried the numbers so deep that its own inspector general had to cite congressional researchers for the count.
They hide the damage because they don’t want you to know the price.
[Donate to our campaign and help us elect a combat aviator who will drag the full cost into daylight.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8_aLWLQLe75qlrYhpfqQJBiGMFNGi_7PLdNzOKPnIlYQ0UimWFMdY6MBY0eMYarUWujPrmt9KfpQSbpyod-WC6wd0j__gz2p82Jj-xObAQ4-JRnZEzivZjVU1S5I0ubqmdM_nU6s9X_Mv5cvy7G3Uk-y3dO3ZFiVtdIWaau-Gw67YeBJkqj-qlf46c3p2dm_Jt77_OueCAiyTCn9Uikm3U2x3HhVZV3mx5jffhEDBGF1Bij9yt0KqMtYF-wVxJ6Lj4QhE6PwUm3GKxxwmaoLqz261viH5HkDhqTkzJB9BnKH2N-QBqFibZm0DVznJtGX2Se-iXrx8tbEB-K3fNKOOYz72FsWSZabk_c0zBGQRaQL/4ut/p4tteztrQ5uEvHxEh8f7MQ/h3/h001.HGfdEZmQOZOUoSSM41yLoNO-6KNFG6bxM6Jyl7evbOQ)
This game of hide-and-seek goes far beyond shuffling spreadsheets and canceling press conferences.
In the wake of these reports, Senator Chris Murphy flew to the Gulf to inspect the damage himself.
They denied a U.S. Senator entry to our bases and even blocked him from meeting with military leaders – an order that reportedly came from Hegseth himself.
Congressional oversight of the military is a constitutional command, written into the separation of powers because the founders refused to let any executive wage war in the dark.
A failed cable-news host playing war games does not outrank the Constitution of the United States.
Defying it is unconstitutional obstruction and impeachable.
As a Take BAC Congress candidate, I stand with grassroots Democrats across this country and pledge to hold this administration accountable for its crimes.
And we’ve built the movement to get the job done.

clean_body: | | Peter, I keep having to write to you about this administration hiding the cost of its illegal war, and every installment is worse than the last. First, Trump claimed " no damage, no losses, no nothing" until leaked photos from our own bases proved otherwise, and the bill ran to billions a month. Then they pulled the ultimate coward's move and suppressed reporting of our war casualties. Now congressional researchers report 81 American military aircraft destroyed or damaged in this war, worth up to $3.3 billion, including an F-35 and an E-3 Sentry. | I served in the Air Force for 20 years and flew many combat missions, so let me translate those losses. The F-35 is the crown jewel of American airpower, $80 million apiece, and this war has cost us one. The E-3 watches the sky for everyone else, and crews depend on it to come home alive. These losses put every American still flying out there in danger. And every dollar of those losses comes out of your wallet. Taxpayers are footing the bill for a war run by amateurs, and the Pentagon buried the numbers so deep that its own inspector general had to cite congressional researchers for the count. They hide the damage because they don’t want you to know the price. This game of hide-and-seek goes far beyond shuffling spreadsheets and canceling press conferences. In the wake of these reports, Senator Chris Murphy flew to the Gulf to inspect the damage himself. They denied a U.S. Senator entry to our bases and even blocked him from meeting with military leaders – an order that reportedly came from Hegseth himself. Congressional oversight of the military is a constitutional command, written into the separation of powers because the founders refused to let any executive wage war in the dark. A failed cable-news host playing war games does not outrank the Constitution of the United States. Defying it is unconstitutional obstruction and impeachable. As a Take BAC Congress candidate, I stand with grassroots Democrats across this country and pledge to hold this administration accountable for its crimes. And we’ve built the movement to get the job done. | When I’m elected, I will support articles of impeachment for Trump and Hegseth both, subpoenas for every hidden casualty report, and answers for every family still in the dark. Keith Self has proven he will defend all of it to the bitter rotten end, which is why the accountability starts with his seat. ---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** October 12th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |
**CONCORD, N.H. —** Tonight, Stefany Shaheen is holding a campaign event with House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries. New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie issued the following statement in response:“Yet again, Silver Spoon Stefany is aligning herself with the far left of her party,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “Hakeem Jeffries led the charge to block tax relief on tips, overtime, and Social Security, while supporting policies that increase costs for Granite Staters. He also helped drive the government shutdown. Now, Stefany is campaigning alongside her party’s top leadership, showing Granite Staters exactly where her priorities lie.”“Instead of meeting Granite Staters where they are, Stefany is rubbing shoulders with Washington insiders. She would be a rubber stamp for her party’s leadership, not an independent voice for New Hampshire.”

We honor their ancestral lands and celebrate the **enduring, vital contributions of Indigenous communities across Southern Arizona!**
Recent news of the destruction of the sacred 300-year-old Cottonwood tree for border wall expansion broke last week. This is disgraceful but **WE have the power** to turn our anger into unstoppable change.
**Adelita is a fierce, unwavering champion** for Indigenous communities in Washington, and we need to send her back to keep up the fight. | **Governor Scott Releases “My Commitment to You”**
**_Governor Highlights Plans to Put
Vermont on a Stronger Path_**
Montpelier, Vt – Governor Phil Scott today released a new 60-second video, _“My Commitment to You,”_ highlighting his priorities for the next two years.

[](https://us.list-manage.com/1BDR3mIxqJI?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c)

In the new video, Governor Scott reflects on the challenges Vermonters have faced, the progress made through hard work and determination, and the opportunity to build a stronger future with more good jobs, more families, and thriving communities.

**“Vermonters have been through a lot, and we’ve accomplished some tough things together. But there’s more work to do. We need to build more homes, strengthen schools and hospitals, lower costs, and give working families and small businesses a better chance to succeed,” Governor Scott said.**

**“I have the experience, determination, and real plans to make progress. And if there is enough support in the Legislature, I know we can get it done,” he added.**

The video also acknowledges the challenges Washington will present over the next two years, and emphasizes the Governor’s commitment to steady leadership that always puts Vermonters first.

**“There’s going to be plenty of noise and division coming out of Washington, and I’ll continue to work with Democratic and Republican governors from around the country to protect Vermont and the rights of all Americans. We also must move forward with the work we need to do here at home to put Vermont on a stronger path,” the Governor said.**

**“Together, and with a Legislature that agrees, we will grow Vermont’s economy and make it more affordable for everyone. That’s my commitment to you.”**

A new poll out of Texas shows Democrat James Talarico jumping to a 5-point lead over Attorney General Ken Paxton in the race for U.S. Senate – his largest lead of the entire general election. This is a race that could decide who controls the Senate.

This is the same James Talarico who claimed the Bible is pro-abortion and called himself a “Christian who hates Christianity.”

*** Granting statehood to Puerto Rico & Washington, D.C. to lock in four “blue” seats and secure Democrat control of the U.S. Senate for decades;

*** Open borders immigration to flood our country with criminals, scammers, and future voters for their socialist agenda;

*** Preventing election integrity laws to ensure they never lose power again; and

*** Packing the courts to rubber-stamp their entire agenda. And Texas isn’t the only place Republicans could lose the Senate this fall.

In New Hampshire, our endorsed candidate, John Sununu, and other America First Republicans are fighting for open seats in a state the Left is targeting hard this cycle.

Nevada, New Hampshire, and Arizona all have critical races in play too, with Democratic Socialists riding the DNC’s money into Washington, D.C.

If Republicans lose Congress, Friend, every America First win we’ve fought for since 2024 is on the chopping block.

So here’s our plan to BUILD the RED WALL in 2026: **> >> BALLOT CHASING.** We’re funding the largest ballot-chasing operation in history. Our trained ballot chasers into the most contested precincts, going into communities well ahead of Election Day to build real relationships with voters – because too many patriots don’t realize what’s on the ballot until it’s too late.

**> >> DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING.** Nothing moves a voter like a face-to-face conversation. We’re sending our ballot chasers knocking on doors in the most contested battlegrounds to make sure America First voters actually turn out.

**> >> VOTER OUTREACH.** Phone calls, peer-to-peer texts, and personal contact with America First voters who need to hear, directly from us, what’s at stake if we lose in November. We’re not the ones with a $546 million war chest. We’re the grassroots army that wins with boots on the ground, not slush funds.

And Friend, that’s exactly why it works.

Personal contact from one of our ballot chasers at your door moves more votes than a Hollywood ad ever will – and we’ve proven it, election after election.

clean_body: The dubbed "Stop Nick Shirley Act" was made to stop me. | | | | | | | Friend, There's now a law in California with my name associated with it. Everyone in Sacramento knows exactly what the "Stop Nick Shirley Act" means. On August 22nd, Governor Newsom signed AB 2624. Three days later, I was standing at the State Capitol with a crowd of people who showed up because they understood what this law actually does. Supporters say it protects immigration workers from harassment. Here's what it really does, Friend: it makes it harder for anyone -- me included -- to investigate where your tax dollars are being sent. I said it plainly at the rally: this is not the end; this is just the beginning. Because here's the part that should bother you more than anything else. The assemblymember who wrote this bill is married to California's Attorney General -- the one person in this state whose entire job is supposed to be going after fraud. Instead, his wife wrote the bill that makes it harder to expose it. That's not a coincidence, Friend. That's the system protecting itself. I've spent the last year showing up where legacy media won't -- daycare centers, tax-funded nonprofits, the offices of people who'd rather I disappear than answer a question. That work is exactly why a state legislature decided to write a law with my name on it instead of going after the fraud I keep finding. A state senator at the rally called it unconstitutional. A city attorney called it a direct threat to the First Amendment. They're right -- and they're not going to be the ones who stop it. That's going to take people willing to fund the reporters still asking the questions. Here's something most people don't see, Friend: doing this work independently means there's no network paying for the flight to Sacramento, no legal department covering me if a state files a complaint over a story, no corporate budget for the cameras and editors it takes to get this footage in front of you. When I showed up at that rally, Lincoln Media Foundation was on site with their own journalists to cover it, because they understood what was actually at stake before most of the country did. That 's why I'm partnering with Lincoln Media Foundation. They understand how important it is to support independent journalists and help us keep doing the work without compromising what makes it independent in the first place. I'm grateful for their partnership and commitment, and - helping cover travel, equipment, and the costs that come with confronting people on camera instead of reading a press release about them. Since LMF is a 501(c)3, your gift is tax-deductible , and it can be made anonymously if that's what you'd prefer. Friend, they can pass all the laws they want. They can try to prevent people like me from exposing their corruption, that's why it crucial to support independent journalists like myself. Team,

This week, Matsui declared that ICE is "beyond reform" — that we must "tear it down" and build an immigration system rooted in human dignity and the rule of law.

Strong words. I agree with every one of them.

There's just one problem: Doris Matsui spent years funding the very agency she now says we must tear down.

**Between 2019 and 2024, Matsui voted YEA five separate times on federal spending packages that together delivered at least $42 billion to ICE.**

[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquO38L98SklfBdoDq94y0bmUz2y0R042cuXgtd2CLghMZ0bhbHXmGQDYyQ86Cx7dNNuXH_6cqzlXzCb-dsZ_6oD5mAhIiV8DeKlTBE9rY9iAG3q-hgNQ0zlRwHQD0Y8lqKOXAuoYfY3YOOpAZIsgkGGBwn9kNBIk55_mIP6Qn17u7s_zfkqr0JVT_LopMbS48UAUUV_Kj2p0MsImCG2f-GRKeWDvvgH7iHLQJM5FT74yY2T2cj4El7waoT3gLslZggYFGL2SaqOVSnvMpU2Jc_XJ8b_u0vFLnW7Vw2auR1MF7qp1Qw_CFKSZO4OUo2bPqBK4p6xcOV7vgSWsnncSh5k4uUpo6Rxxa_qcu_s-8Pgt82VtsGxSPqxvnx1ty5pjwo/4ut/_Jg98XfiReeeBL2hRE4KnA/h1/h001.zGbJoztGILw1pF5NhLA2VvhwWnpdUu4WxKNitYd06AQ) _Pablo Manríquez, “Matsui Said ‘Hell No’ to ICE Funding. Her Voting Record Says Otherwise,” Migrant Insider, April 18, 2026._

Every one of these votes is a matter of public congressional record, and here's the part she's hoping you won't notice: every single one of them happened before I entered this race — before Doris Matsui suddenly reinvented herself as a critic of ICE.

The truth is she’s always had the power to stand up to this agency. Instead, she funded it, again and again, to the tune of nearly $42 billion. It was only when she drew a primary challenger who has always called to abolish ICE that she discovered her outrage.

**That’s what a politician does when they’re worried about losing power.**

I didn't find my position on ICE when it became convenient. And unlike my opponent, I have never taken a dime from ICE contractors who profit off it, and I never will.

clean_body: We are the cavalry. We are who takes this country back. | | | | = | | | Peter, Look, when I first jumped into the race to beat Mike Lawler and flip NY-17, I really didn’t know what to expect. I knew that it was going to be a hard fight. We had an initial roadmap. But a lot of it was a shot in the dark. One thing I knew for sure: I would need a massive team behind me. Now, heading into the final stretch, we've built that team. A huge chunk of our budget comes from people giving $10 or $20 to emails like this one. And with that support, we’ve built an operation that has turned this Lean-R district into a tossup. Nate Silver calls us one of three races most likely to determine control of the House. I’m incredibly proud of that, and I hope you are too. Over 250 years our nation has gone through really dark times, really hard chapters. In these extraordinary moments, ordinary people rose up and chose to live with courage. They knew America and our democracy is worth fighting for. The ending to this chapter in American history is not yet written. Who we become, the values that define us, that is up to us. We are the cavalry. We are who takes this country back. It’s up to us to beat Lawler, flip NY-17, and take back the House for Democrats. I know we can do that, but we can’t do it without you. I was raised by cattle ranchers who taught me the value of hard work and that earning a living takes early mornings, long nights, and getting your hands dirty.

subject: Ballots subject for destruction
body:
Must read

| | | | | |

| |

Friends,
**I have received unfortunate news from my attorney.**
Tomorrow, the Riverside County Registrar of Voters will **destroy all ballots** that were subject to our warranted investigation into the Prop 50 election. You read that correctly.
**This is exactly what AG Rob Bonta wanted** — for trust in our elections to be buried, along with any evidence of a crime. Due to the recent California Supreme Court ruling, the Attorney General now has the authority to shut down any investigation he wants.
---
| | | | | [Support Election Integrity](https://us.list-manage.com/ZvOTRoHPc9K?e=1facf02470&c2id=205919520b3860dafbe9b9f5dda2019d)
---
| |
This isn’t just lawfare against one sheriff; it’s a corrupt legal system that now allows **destruction of evidence**. The integrity of our elections is being eroded by a small group of people who put their own special interests above the **people’s trust in our institutions**.
These are sad days for California, but I still believe there are brighter days to come. I still and always will believe that nothing is ever truly covered up. I don’t have to tell you why our AG was terrified that an experienced sheriff was investigating election fraud.

The truth is yours to know.
Sheriff Chad Bianco
Riverside County

| | Folks, in 2018, I ran against a sitting Republican incumbent in a toss-up district. Not many people in Washington gave me much of a chance. I didn't win that race by having the most money. I won it through teamwork and determination: knocking doors, making calls, and showing up in every corner of Hampton Roads. On Election Day, I flipped VA-02 blue. I'm running the final stretch of this race the exact same way. Here's where things stand:
* Kiggans' campaign has already spent **more than double** what we have.
* Trump's PAC just poured in **$1.5 million** to run ads for his “warrior” Jen Kiggans.
* MAGA has spent **more than $6.5 million** in this district to bury me.

I'm not telling you this to scare you. I've been here before: in 2022, outside far-right groups spent $6,059,677 against me. _They’re trying to count us out._ So let me be plain: **I'm going to be outspent. I will not be outworked.** They have Trump's PAC and the MAGA political machine. I met the Good Samaritan in Whitesburg, Kentucky
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141273335/653013065/-1038038363?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_Whitesburg_261012_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc5YmQzZDUtOTBjNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mV_g7UKcyevSg8FLQZrayw-ScFgizs1Dir4lTH4czCM=&emci=e45e8c8e-6fc6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=179bd3d5-90c6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=17458827)
Peter, if you ever lose faith in humanity, look at what people do after a natural disaster.

In July 2022, eastern Kentucky was hit with unprecedented floods. As soon as the first reports of the devastation started rolling in, I knew I had to be there, on the ground with my fellow Kentuckians.

In Whitesburg, Kentucky, I came upon a house where five or six people were hard at work, clearing debris and dragging ruined belongings to the curb. One woman was working so hard that I figured it had to be her house.

I told her how sorry I was, and that it must be tough to see her home like this.

"We'll get to mine later," she said. "I thought I'd start with my neighbor."

**Peter, In This Together PAC exists to support candidates who believe that our politics should reflect that same spirit of doing right by our neighbors.**

[_**Will you donate during these final few weeks to elect candidates who will always put our people first?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141273336/653013066/-2107112631?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_Whitesburg_261012_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc5YmQzZDUtOTBjNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mV_g7UKcyevSg8FLQZrayw-ScFgizs1Dir4lTH4czCM=)

In Whitesburg, I saw the kindness and generosity of people during one of the hardest times of their lives. In the face of unimaginable tragedy, I saw neighbors helping neighbors. A community coming together and supporting one another.

That’s the best of us — and at our core, that’s what this country is all about.

But too often, our politics doesn’t reflect those values. Too many people try to tear us apart and tell us to distrust one another. It’s wrong.

This November, I'm supporting candidates who are committed to leading with empathy and compassion.

[_**I hope you’ll join me in supporting these candidates by making a donation to In This Together PAC today. Your support helps elect good people who will always do the right thing, even in the toughest times.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141273337/653013067/-2107112631?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_Whitesburg_261012_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTc5YmQzZDUtOTBjNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mV_g7UKcyevSg8FLQZrayw-ScFgizs1Dir4lTH4czCM=)

Thank you for your support,

Andy | | ****Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear and In This Together PAC are working to support leaders who will lead with compassion and decency, reject anger politics, and always do what's right. body:
No matter the odds, people stepping forward and speaking out still matters.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141273882/653014913/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM1NmViZDFjLTkyYzYtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=YovoPfNRYBpSWzQcrMTFUTnSGYb9tv1FMEY7GFXUVM8=&emci=107afbcd-23c4-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=356ebd1c-92c6-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=8431045)
---

Hi Peter, here’s why it’s a big deal that the Supreme Court blocked the use of Missouri’s mid-decade congressional gerrymander. This is what can happen when citizens are empowered, stay engaged, and commit to the struggle for our democracy. Against all the odds and facing a court system that has shown itself to bend over backward to favor Republicans, **grassroots organizing still works.** It helps to take a step back to look at the full picture: | “While Missouri Republicans took directions from the White House instead of their own constituents, Missourians stood up for themselves and gave a resounding ‘NO’ to the power-hungry politicians trying to slice up their communities for partisan gain. Citizens organized, protested, and took this fight all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court — not once, not twice, but three times — and they won the fight to block the installation of an egregious mid-decade gerrymander for the 2026 midterms. **Because of their tenacity, Missourians will continue to vote in this election on a fairer congressional map that keeps Kansas City together.”** —Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General of the United States
---
The plaintiffs in the case were backed by the full force of the fair maps movement— which played a crucial role in securing the victory. When Republicans launched this attack, they had no idea how hard the people would fight back.
Now, as they continue to threaten our rights, we must never forget the lesson from Missouri: **United, we are more powerful than anti-democracy special interests.** In A.G. Holder’s words:
“The story of the fight for democracy in Missouri is an example for the nation as we continue the struggle to protect the right to vote. There is no cavalry coming to save us — we, the people, are the cavalry.”
---
The NDRC is going toe to toe with the Republican threats to democracy and fighting back against attempts to erode its most basic functions, especially the right to vote.
We have just a matter of a few weeks to make major headway toward that goal — in Missouri, that means passing the citizen-led referendum to reject the 2025 gerrymander for good. And across the country, we’re supporting over 300 pro-democracy candidates on the ballot in key state-level races.
[**Peter, we’re counting on your support to give those top electoral priorities a boost right now, when it matters most. clean_body: No matter the odds, people stepping forward and speaking out still matters. | Hi Peter, here’s why it’s a big deal that the Supreme Court blocked the use of Missouri’s mid-decade congressional gerrymander. This is what can happen when citizens are empowered, stay engaged, and commit to the struggle for our democracy. Against all the odds and facing a court system that has shown itself to bend over backward to favor Republicans, grassroots organizing still works. It helps to take a step back to look at the full picture: | “While Missouri Republicans took directions from the White House instead of their own constituents, Missourians stood up for themselves and gave a resounding ‘NO’ to the power-hungry politicians trying to slice up their communities for partisan gain. Citizens organized, protested, and took this fight all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court — not once, not twice, but three times — and they won the fight to block the installation of an egregious mid-decade gerrymander for the 2026 midterms. Because of their tenacity, Missourians will continue to vote in this election on a fairer congressional map that keeps Kansas City together.” —Eric H. Holder, Jr. 82nd Attorney General of the United States The plaintiffs in the case were backed by the full force of the fair maps movement— which played a crucial role in securing the victory. When Republicans launched this attack, they had no idea how hard the people would fight back. Now, as they continue to threaten our rights, we must never forget the lesson from Missouri: United, we are more powerful than anti-democracy special interests. In A.G. Holder’s words: “The story of the fight for democracy in Missouri is an example for the nation as we continue the struggle to protect the right to vote. There is no cavalry coming to save us — we, the people, are the cavalry.” The NDRC is going toe to toe with the Republican threats to democracy and fighting back against attempts to erode its most basic functions, especially the right to vote. We have just a matter of a few weeks to make major headway toward that goal — in Missouri, that means passing the citizen-led referendum to reject the 2025 gerrymander for good. clean_body: We’re not convinced by Tom Barrett’s anti-AI act, and neither are the Big Tech billionaires and PACs who are propping up his campaign. | | | Peter, Michigan’s Tom Barrett is hiding from his record on AI and data centers. We won’t let him. While he puts out a misleading ad pretending to care about Big Tech’s dangerous overreaches, we know what his real record shows: including votes just last year to speed up data center construction and bar state and local governments from regulating AI for 10 years. 1 His opponent, WFP champion Will Lawrence, is a leading voice in support of a federal data center moratorium, and has released a detailed plan to stop tech overreach, protect our air and water, and create a national jobs program funded by a tax on AI profits. We’re not convinced by Tom Barrett’s anti-AI act, and neither are the Big Tech billionaires and PACs who are propping up his campaign. After winning in 2024 thanks to nearly $1 million from Elon Musk’s super PAC, Barrett received maxed-out donations from Palantir founder Peter Thiel and Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwartzman, as well as major contributions from the corporate PACs for Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Oracle.2 These billionaires and corporations know that flipping this seat and electing Will Lawrence will put a dent in their plans to recklessly develop AI and build endless data centers — which have been jacking up utility prices and hurting the environment in communities around the country. Will is a proven leader who is ready to take on these destructive data centers and stand up to the billionaires trying to buy our elections. But with only a few weeks until Election Day, we don’t have much time to spare. In solidarity, Team WFP Source: 1\. , Michigan Advance, October 7, 2026 2\. , The American Prospect, August 20, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. **Zoom Meeting (Special Guest Lisa Demuth)**
Tonight at 8:30 PM is a special Zoom Update. Lisa Demuth herself will be in attendance and give a brief speech to the assembled volunteers. We encourage everyone who has been a volunteer for the campaign to be on the call!
I have placed the link below. Once you click the link, you will be taken into a waiting room. I will let you into the meeting from there.
https://us06web.zoom.us/j/87316568944

If you are interested in joining our efforts in knocking on doors and calling phones, please contact Caleb Jungling. Email me at logan@lisaformn.com**Events** At this point in the campaign, there are dozens of door-knocking and phone-calling events taking place all over the state. For example, tomorrow at the Ultimate Sports Bar & Grill in Waite Park, MN, there is a door-knocking event from 12:00 to 4:00. Arrive for lunch at 12:00 and then go out door-knocking at 1:00 PM. We are urging all local volunteers to attend! This is just one of many events happening. If you would like to attend one happening near you, please contact Caleb Jungling at caleb@mngop.com

# MEDIA ADVISORY

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
October 12, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com
**LILY TANG WILLIAMS RAMPS UP GENERAL ELECTION PUSH WITH CONCORD AND LITTLETON TOWN HALLS, NHPR FORUM**
WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams continues her aggressive district-wide campaign this week with two more _Ask Me Anything _town halls in Concord and Littleton, while taking her fight for affordability and the American Dream directly to Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander at Thursday’s NHPR congressional forum. Williams continues to meet Granite Staters face-to-face, taking unscripted questions on any issue without restrictions or pre-screening.
**UPCOMING EVENTS:** **TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13 — CONCORD AMA TOWN HALL** 6:30–8:00 PM
Sweeney Auditorium, NHTI
31 College Drive, Concord, NH **THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15 — NHPR CONGRESSIONAL FORUM** 6:00–8:00 PM (doors open at 5:00 PM)
Brewbakers Café
48 Emerald Street, Keene, NH _Williams will be available for media interviews immediately following the forum._ **SUNDAY, OCTOBER 18 — LITTLETON AMA TOWN HALL** 1:30–3:00 PM
Heald Room, Littleton Community Center
120 Main Street, Littleton, NH
**_NOTE:_**_ Members of the press are encouraged to attend both town halls and the availability following Thursday’s NHPR forum. Both town halls are free and open to the public, with no questions off-limits._

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.
